rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba la 'grel chen sgron gsal yang rdzogs par song*/ phyogs kyi bla ma sogs 'dus che ba la rtag brtan rang na yod pa'i zab sku rnams las mgon po lcam dral ma gtogs thams cad bkram pa'i dga' ston cig kyang byas/ 'di skabs lha 'ga' zhig gi sku sha la gos chen ri mo can yod pas/ de la skyon ngos 'dzin gyi khung gis/ la la na re/ sku sha la gos chen 'jam byus rang dga' ba yong gin 'dugacig ge cig dang ma ge cig na 'jam byus rang yod zer mkhan 'dra byung*/ de la ngas sku sha la 'jam byus byung na dga' ba nged kyis ma shes pa rang ta min/ lar nged cag mkhas po rang ta min kyang de tsam gyi nyams rang ta los yod/ nged rang gis ni lag tu gang byung de ka la bzhengs pa min pa/ mi nor po che tsho byed byed kyi 'dam kha nged sprang po cig gis ga la 'ong yin na'ang*/ stod mtho sa tsho ras dar dang rgyu ngan pa byas/ smad mi'i lag pas reg sa la bzang bzang 'dra btang*/ 'gram pa dang ske nas ral yod pa de 'dra ni nged kyis bzhengs ma myong*/ dus phyis sde dpon ni 'di 'dra bzhengs mkhan yang dkon/ re tsam yod srid de skye bo 'jig rten pa la kho tsho chos pa min 'jig rten pa yin byas pas ka don go ba de yin/ bla ma grag thal can rang ha las ko las khyu cig 'dug ste/ 'di 'dra'i rigs bzhengs mkhan rang mang po e yod mi shes/ yod rang yod na 'di 'dra ba cig 'ong*/ nor grag shos thams cad bkros nas/ 'di yang nga la dgos/ de yang nga la dgos snyams nas rgya rim pa bdun gyi btab nas 'joganor yang btsun pa la mkho mi mkho dang*/ bcang du rung mi rung gi dbye ba med/ byung na byung tshad dgos/ de yang bla ma 'ga' zhig skye ba rting ma'i nor byed zer nas phung 'gong la sprod/ 'ga' zhig shi ba'i rjes de yon bdag gis sdud/ la la tsho'i shul gnyen tshan gyi 'khyer/ la la tsho nye gnas kyis longs spyod pa cig gda'/

gang ltar yang gzhan la gtong ma bra bar sbas pa'i lhag nor 'bring man chad tsho/ rang gson po'i skabs su phal cher mi'i ngos 'dzin la ster/ 'ga' zhig mi bsod pa'i rngan pa dang*/ nor 'phrog pa'i rngan pa dang*/ sa cha 'phrog pa'i rngan pa dang*/ dmag bskul byas pa'i rngan pa la ster/ sdig pa'i g.yos sbyor chen po de bstan pa la phan pa'i phyir yin zer/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa yin zer/ nyes pa med phan yon yod zer/ 'o sdig pa 'ba' zhig gis bstan pa 'dzin dgos kha'i sangs rgyas de rang sangs rgyas byas pa rang gis phud gda'o/ / yang de tsho la ma dgos pa'i yo byad mang po cig ni rang ngam/ rang gi g.yog rigs rnams kyis chang 'tshong ma dang*/ smad 'tshong ma sogs bag med kyi spyod pa tho cho'i rin la gtong*/ de tsho la ma song ba'i lhag ma 'dra byung na skabs re dge las 'dra yang byed kyin yod pa yin las che/ de tsa na gdong nas nor che rang grags pa de'i stabs kyis ri mo yod med la 'dam kha byung ba yin nam/ khyed rnams kyis gzigs gda' ba zer ba byas/ don la de kha lags kyang lags/ nga ni rang gis ma go zhing nor na thabs med/ / go bzhin du bsam pa skyon can gyi rdzun ni byas kyang ma byas/ byed kyang mi byed/ gtam na drang po 'di smra ba yin/ bden gtam lab pa de gzhan gyi skyon brjod du song na'ang gzhan tsho rang la nyes pa yong ba de'i skyon yin/ nga la gyod cang med do/ / ma yin pa cig yin par bsgom/ de 'dra log shes kho na yin/ yin la yin par shes/ de kho na nyid yid la byed pa zer sprang po sgrol mgon kho'i kha khyed rnams kyi cung sdom mi thub bo/ khyed rang rnams chos bzhin byas byung na ni/ nga'i kha khebs yin pa go bar mdzod/ hor zla lnga drug mtshams la chos lung byang rtser phyin/ bde mchog pho brang gi khang pa la rab gnas dang*/ gzhan rten 'brel gyi legs lam 'dra yang bsgrigs/ lo 'di'i nang du zab yongs kyi g.yon phyogs sde yangs kyi 'phraus dang*/

rdo skas mang po dang*/ padma gling gi rtse sgron pa dang*/ mkhar las ci rigs pa'ang byas/ hor zla gsum pa'i nang la snye mo ba'i yig mkhan rnams sleb/ bzhi pa'i stod la g.ye ba'i yig mkhan rnams kyang 'byor zhing*/ stod smad 'di rnams nas yig mkhan thor bu ba rnams dang*/ rtag brtan bzhi pa'i yig mkhan dang bcas pa yongs sdom pa la/ yig mkhan brgya dang brgyad cu skor 'dzoms nas/ bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal 'bri ba'i 'go brtsams/ hor zla dgu pa'i nang du rtsi gras sogs mtha' dag rdzogs par gegs med du legs par zin/ bstan 'gyur 'di la ma dpe la po ti brgya bdun cu skor 'dugalhag por bzhengs pa'i po ti yang mang du yod pas/ yongs dril sdeb de la po ti nyis brgyar nye ba bzhengs/ shog grangs sum brgya drug cu re la po ti re'i rtsi su bcad pa'i po ti re la yon khal drug cu re'i bcad thang byed kyi yod par 'dug na'ang*/ rten gsum bzhengs pa gal che ba'i dbang du byas/ po ti re la khal brgya re'i rtsi'i 'gro nges kyi yon dang*/ rgyun gyi phogs dang ja chang thug pa sogs dang skabs kyi ston mo yang ci bzang du byas/ yig mkhan rnams kyang mgu bar gyur/ lar sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzheng pa la bzo bo ma mgu na/ rten de byin rlabs chung ba yin par 'dugade'i rgyu mtshan yang gtso bor yon bdag gi tshogs ma rdzogs pa dang*/ gnas skabs su rten de'i byed pa po bzo bo yin pa'i rten 'brel du gda'/ na ning snga mo cig bla dpon 'gangs ches rang de 'dra ru/ ri mo ba lnga bcu tsam gyis dbyar zangs 'du khang gi logs bris bris pas gla la ja chang 'dra sig cig las ma byung bar bzo bo thams cad 'u thugasprul sku snar thang pas dus pa'i lo rgyus yod/ nged kyis ni snga phyir rten bzhengs tshad la/ bzo bo shin tu mgu ba 'ba' zhig byas so/ / de bzhin du gzhan yang rab gnas mkhan po dang*/

dbang bskur mkhan po la de bas kyang lhag pa dgos rgyu yin par 'dug ste/ deng sang ni phal cig rab gnas bcol ba rang gis rgyal/ dbang zhus pa rang gis drin che snyam pa byed par 'dug ste/ tshe 'di phyi thams cad kyi rten 'brel kha phud la song ba yin/ yang lo 'di kha'i hor zla gsum pa bzhi pa'i mtshams nas 'go brtsams bdun pa'i 'go la rgyal ba ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba mi pham byams pa mgon po'i zab sku chen mo yang legs par bzhengs grub ste/ 'di la gtso bo byams mgon/ ldems la sher phyin dang sgrol ma/ steng na 'od dpag med dang jo bo spyan ras gzigs bde ldan phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas g.yon du 'phags pa thogs med dang kun mkhyen chen po/ 'og phyogs su gur gyi mgon po dang bcas pa bzhugs/ sku'i rgyu tshogs la zab yug rtog sgril ma bris ma phog pa brgya skor dang*/ gzhan zab che na kha bcu drug tsam la yug tu brtsis pa'i dbang du byas na/ lhag po yug bdun cu skor song*/ mdor na bcad tshun chod yongs gril la zab chen yug brgya bdun bcu skor dang*/ skud rgyu rang la'ang dar yug nyi shu rtsa 'dren skor/ rgyab sha mu 'gril sogs cha tshang bar grub/ 'di dag la ci tsam song gi deb gter yi ge logs na yod/ tshes brgyad la nang gi rab gnas legs par byas/ bdun pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la phyi'i rab gnas zhal 'byed dga' ston la 'di nyid kyi chos sde/ sgrub sde phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i skya ser grangs mang ba dang bcas pa la dga' ston dkyus ma rnams las kyang lhag des shes pa sgrubs/ dbyar stod chos lung byang rtser yod dus/ rtse nas 'bod mi zhig gnang byung ba/ dbang rjes gnang gi khyad 'dra byung gsung pa ma gtogs/ sku don gsar pa gzhan gang yang mi 'dug pas/ zab sku bzhengs grub rting yong khul gyi 'gyangs cha tsam zhus/ de rjes hor zla drug pa'i nyer dgu gnam gang la yang mi sna cig 'byor ba'i bdun pa'i tshes lnga la lcam bgres pa phyir thags mdzad rgyu yin pas/

thegs gong du dbang chos zhu dgos yin pas yong dgos gsung ba zhig byung na'ang*/ dus thug pas thegs gong slebs mi thub par 'dug nas/ mar phyogs 'byor thub pa ma byung*/ bskul bcag pa bcar sdod yod pa tsho yang slog nas/ ston kha 'byor ba'i khas len zhus/ sngar lhun grub sgang pa rang rdib pa'i dus/ la stod lhor sdud mkhan lhun grub sgang pa bstan 'dzin spun gnyis po brag stod dgon par skyabs bcol/ lo cig gi ring dud 'gro mang pos rtsa zos/ sde srid la'ang ngo chen nan bcags dgos zer sa skal ci rigs pa'i bka' shog kyang gnang ba yin na'ang*/ 'di skabs kha bslu byas nas sa skyar song*/ rtsa rin sogs ni ga la sprod/ dgra ngos len byed rgyu'i khungs byed kyin 'duganged kyis snga ma nas go ste/ dam sel can de rnams 'dir ma byung rung legs snyam ste ci bder bzhag pa yin/ btsun ma gnyis kyang snga sor jo nang pa'i bstan pa las gzhan la mi 'jug pa'i mna' bskyal yang*/ de gong nas ma bsdad par song ba de yang legs pa rang cig lags/ yang byams pa'i zab sku bzhengs grub ma thag tu/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zab sku dkyus su 'doms phyed dang bdun yod pa 'di bzheng*/ 'khor dbyangs can ma dang nor rgyun ma gnyis yod/ 'di'i sku rgyu la zab chen yug tshad nyi shu rtsa lnga/ kha mthor mang rab dang bcas pa song*/ zhag nyi shu rtsa bdun tsam gyi khongs su cha tshang grub/ rab gnas tshun chod mtha' rgyas su song*/ 'dir smras pa/ tshogs kyi sgo chen brgya phyi nas/ / rnam par grol ba'i khang bzangs der/ / bdag gzhan mtha' dag 'jug byed pa/ / 'di ko ngo mtshar cis mi che/ / bsod nams ye shes rgyu tshogs ni/ / mtha' yas kun gyi rgyab dpung yin/ zhing mchog rdo rje yan lag mar/ / bla na med pa'i rgyud las gsungs/ / shes bya kun gyi de bzhin nyid gang yin/ / lhan cig skyes pa 'gyur med ces bya ba'ang*/

/ thob 'gyur thabs ni tshogs gsum las gzhan med/ / de phyir 'di la ngas kyang 'bad par byas/ / ji skad du/ bsam pa gang dang gang gis ni/ / mi rnams yid ni yang dag sbyor/ / de de'i rang bzhin 'gyur lha mo/ / sna tshogs gzugs can nor bu bzhin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang dang gang bsgoms pa de dang de gsal bar snang ba'i tshul ni los yin/ dang po ngas gnas lugs phyag rgya chen por grags pa rang rkangs su btsugs nas/ gzhan rnams cha lag tu khyer phyin pa'i skabs/ stong pa kho nas yul dus thams cad khyab par brdal ba la/ rtsal thams cad ma 'gags par 'char ba cig byung ste/ zung 'jug yin snyam kyang*/ rtsal de thams cad stong pa de kha las ma 'das pas/ stong rkyang du ka 'dugaphyis 'byung zung 'jug gi lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gzhung bsrangs pas/ sngar gyi rtsal ma 'gags bya ba'i rtsal thams cad kun rdzob kyi snang char myong*/ de tsam la rag ma lus pa'i stong pa de mthar gtugs na bde bar 'dugabade ba de ye shes rnams pa mtha' yas par rang shar/ shar tsam nyid nas kun rdzob gzung 'dzin gyi dri mas ma gos pa cig 'dug pa de nyams su ni myong*/ the tshom ni chod nges shes ni skyes/ de tsa na gzhan mkhas pa yin/ grub pa yin/ byang sems yin/ sangs rgyas yin/ 'phags pa yin zer yang zer/ yin yin 'dra mdog kha mo yang yod pa/ nam mkha' khengs pa byung nas/ blo gzhan du bsgyur kyang mi 'gyur ba'i gdeng cig ni thob/ mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ta re ba med de/ rjes mthun nyams su myong ba ltar yin par khas len/ gnas skabs 'di dag tu yang*/ sems gsal rig bde ba'i nyams myong 'di/ / gnas phyogs cha med pa mkha' la yas/ / dus rtag tu 'pho 'gyur ye nas sangs/ / don cang med ma yin bde bar myong*/ / de rig kyang myong bya myong byed bral/ / gzhan sdug bsngal dang zug rngu'i ming yang stor/ / 'phral dga' bde srid zhen dbyings su zhi/ / lar btang snyoms ma yin khong nas

bde/ / nang 'khor lo drug gi gzhal yas nas/ khams 'byung lnga dag pa'i ye shes me/ / dbyings stong pa'i dbus su 'bar ba las/ / lus lhan skyes su 'gyur ba 'di rgod re bro/ kho thogs med sems kyi cho 'phrul las/ / phyi gdos bcas kyi snang ba gang 'dod du bsgyur/ / gnad rdo rje lus kyi byed bcings las/ / don gnas lugs mthar thug rtogs pa 'di/ / lus ngag yid rdo rje ro mnyam zhes/ / rgyud kun las gsungs pa'i sgrub byed yin/ / rtsa re re dag pa'i cho 'phrul la/ / phyogs rab 'byams dag pa'i snang bas 'gengs/ / mthu mngon shes sogs yon tan la zad pa med/ / tshig rtog ge mkhan po tsho snying re rje/ / zhes so/ / de ltar smos pa de dang rjes mthun pa tsam ka los yin/ shin tu gsal bar snang ba ni shar ba'ang lags te/ lan cig byung nas nyams rgyu yang mi 'dug go / 'di thugs rdo rje'i rim pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam du gda' lags/ lo 'di'i nang du zar chos 'khor bde chen du ston pa rin po che'i gser sku jo tshad ma dang*/ gsang sngags ri bor yang gser sku mi tshad ma sogs yon mchod tshos bzhengs pa mdzad 'dug pa la/ 'di nas kyang 'thud cung zad phul zhing*/ bzo bo bal po bzhi lnga cig gtong dgos byung*/ spyir 'dus byas kyi dge ba rnam pa du ma yod/ snying rje chen po byang chub kyi sems dang*/ bdag med dang*/ spros bral gyi lta bas zin na thams cad sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu bla na med par 'dugagasum po des ma zin/ thar 'dod kyis kyang ma zin na/ sbyin pa rgya chen po btang kyang*/ byang chub gsum gyi rgyur ma nges/ tshul khrims bsrungs kyang 'jigs skyob bam legs smon du 'gro bas de dang 'dra/ ting nge 'dzin 'jig rten pa dang*/ mngon shes than thun yod kyang mu stegs can gyi dpes mtshon/ so so skye bos byas pa'i gzhung lugs dang*/ sgra sogs phyi'i rigs gnas la bslabs kyang de dag 'dra rung las kyang khyer kha chung*/

rtsa rlung byed zer nas sna bug sha shu 'bud cing*/ 'khrul 'khor thag thig 'dra rgyab kyang 'khor ba'i rgyu ka yin/ las 'bras kyi blang dor ma nor ba cig la gzhi byas nas/ nges 'byung byang sems stong nyid gsum gyi skya bar nas byed na ni/ de thams cad ngo mtshar che/ gzhan ni 'dod pa'i khams su 'khor ba kho nar gda'/ bsam gtan dang*/ gzugs med dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam sogs dus deng sang bshad pa tsam ma gtogs mtha' phyi rdos brdung sar sleb mi 'ong bas re zhig cha la zhogarnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zung 'jug gi lam gyis/ chos dbyings bde gshegs snying po la/ gnyis med ro mnyam du bcang 'jus thub na/ de la 'dus ma byas kyi dge ba zer ba yin/ de yod ba'i thabs thun mong ma yin pa tsho la'ang ma byas pa'i dge ba'i ming 'dogs pa yin/ sdig spong dge ba sgrub pa cig ni los dgos/

phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas mi chung cig song*/ gnyis kyang thal/ da dung btang gi zer ba de 'dra dmyal ba'i 'gram rdo rang lags mod/ de min nges 'byung sogs gzhan grogs su yod na dpal yin/ med kyang 'dus ma byas zung 'jug gi dge ba la thams cad tshang bas/ kho cig chog rgyal po gnam lcags thog dang 'dra/ seng ge ral pa can la gcan gzan gzhan gyi grogs yod kyang bzang ste/ med kyang rang gcig pus mi phyugs thams cad 'ded thub pa yin/ dpa' bo stong thub de lam la 'gro na rang gcig pus chom rkun thams cad 'joms/ grogs zla bo byung na phar la grogs kyi 'jigs pa skyob pa yin/ kho la 'jigs pa skyob mkhan mi dgos/ zung 'jug chen po'i lam 'di bsgom na/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba'ang 'dus ma byas pa'i dge bar gnas 'gyur ba yin/ mthar thug gi chos 'di yar la chod 'gran zla gang yod/ gzhan sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku gzugs bzheng ba/ sangs rgyas dang 'phags mchog rnams kyi bka'i glegs bam 'dri ba/ chos sku'i mchod rten bzhengs pa/ mdo rgyud dang theg chen 'phags pa'i gsung la thos bsam byed pa/ yi dam gyi lha sgom pa/ gzungs sngags zab mo bzla ba/ tha na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs sogs la bltas shing phyag mchod byed pa rnams kyang 'dus byas kyi dge ba ta yin/ che chung gang byed kyang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang chos kyi sku la dmigs pa yin pa'i phyir/ nges 'byung snying rje stong nyid sogs kyis zin na a cang che/ ma zin kyang dus lan cig mi ring bar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu grung po 'chug pa med pa de yin/ mu stegs byed tsho yang byed pa po pa ra me shwa ra'i sku gzugs cig bzhengs na/ bsod nams stong phrag bcu thob zer na/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rten gsum bzhengs pa la yon tan mtha' ci yod/ khong mu stegs pa'i grwa pa phal pa tsho yang*/ dad pa de tsam du yod na/

rang re bod kyi nang pa'i dge bshes tsho la'ang kha bshad kho na ma gtogs lag len du dad pa btsal yang mi rnyed pa 'di 'dra yi re mug na/ dkon mchog spyi la dad pa ye med na/ sha khrag dang bshang gcis gang ba'i mi gcig rdzong rdzong byas bzhag thal mo sbyar sbyar/ mig btsum btsum/ mchu smeg smeg byed pa skad byed pa ni rdzun po che gcig gis mi gcig mgo skor mi gcig mgo 'khor bas yo 'go 'khor zer ba de yin/ gsang bsngags rdo rje theg pa'i dbang rgyud man ngag gi bka' drin thob pa yin na ni ma gtogs so/ / 'phros don no/ / yang dkyus la 'jug ste/ slar yang rtse nas 'bod mkhan gnang byung ba ltar/ lam kha chu byang la brgyud/ ri bo gru 'dzin gyi gdong der yol mo sprul sku mched nged 'phrad par phebs byung*/ yol mo ba rgyal po la brten pa'i gnod pa thu ba cig yong gin 'dug pas skyabs 'jug byed dgos gsung gin 'dugarang re rgyal sras thogs med pa la mos pa'i khungs yin pa la/ de snga sku 'dra byin rlabs can de 'khris su bzhugs kyang ma mjal ba de/ dad pa kha tsam tshig tsam gyi me khams su song 'dug snyam rang la rang gis khrel ba cig kyang byung*/ dngul chu chos rdzong du phyin/ sku 'dra la phyag mchod smon lam yang gang 'grub byas/ 'dra sku rang yin zer yang zer yin yang yin yod par 'dugazhib tu brtags na sku bzhugs dus kyi rnam cha yang nges par 'dug cing*/ nged kyi bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rje dpal chos pa de'i zhal ras rang 'dra ba cig yod par 'dugazhabs pus la mgo bos gtugs shing gsol ba btab pas/ mos gus dang snying rje 'brel ba'i mchi ma rang dbang med par 'khrug pa'i nyams bcos ma min pa cig byung*/ lar snang ba cung zad 'gyur nus pa dkyus ma min pa cig 'dugakhong gi rnam thar la 'jug pa'i smon lam yang yang btab ste/ mos blo ma dor ba tsam ma gtogs tshe 'di la ni mi 'grub pa 'di khar gda'/

da dgos sgrub pa skad byas kyang yun rings med yod pas blo sna mang bar thal/ skye ba 'di'i phyi ma cig la n-i de las kyang mi 'grub pa cig 'duga'on kyang zhing khams rab 'byams su dus mtha' med pa'i bar du sgrub pa yin no/ / de'i sang nyin lam du chas/ dar sdings nas dang*/ zhabs drung shun pa'i mgron gyis lam 'gor che ba cig byung*/ rim pas bsam 'grub rtser 'byor/ dbang dka' rjes gnang rkyen sel sogs dkyus ltar phul/ de lo ser sog nyin cig ma cig ka mdzad song*/ snga sor li ma lha khang rgya bkyed pa gnang ba'i zhal gzigs phyogs sogs thams cad nas zal ba rang byung 'dugathogs mar khang pa la rab gnas dang*/ de rjes li ma rnams la'ang ngos 'dzin zhib par byas nas yi ger 'debs pa gnang*/ rten bsgrigs mchod shoms legs par grub nas kyang/ rten gyi ngo bo'i sgo nas rab gnas mi dgos kyang*/ mchod shoms spyi de la rab gnas mdor bsdus cig byas/ mgon khang 'og na phur pa'am rnying ma lha khang yin phebs pa cig 'dug pa de la'ang nyin gcig rab gnas byas/ gser mdog can gyi dge 'dun rnams sku rim la phebs pa la'ang chos 'brel dang*/ thar pa ba rnams chos bar la'ang byon pa'i thogathog mar bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa skyes bu gsum gyi 'khrid zla gcig tsam bshad/ byams pa nas brgyud pa'i sems bskyed byas/ de rjes dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nag po zhabs lugs kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs tshogs pa thams cad la bskur zhing sde srid kyis kyang gsan/ yang thar pa'i grwa pa byed la gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang*/ phyed la 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i dbang bskur yang byas/ bsam sdings pa'i tshogs pa byon pa la'ang bde mchog lha lnga dang*/ chos drug dang*/ mgon po dkar nag sogs shangs chos ci rigs pa bshad/ byi ri stag rtse nas yin pa'i bstan 'gyur gser ma zhig dang*/ zhal thang mang rab la rab gnas nyin cig ma cig kyang bgyis/

snga phyir lhun grub sgang ba ma chen dang*/ rab brtan lags dang*/ bsod lhun rnams btson dong du 'das pa la/ khong tsho'i chos mdzad bkra shis lhun po na yod pa 'dis re re bzhin bsngo rten dang*/ rtag brtan du mang ja re byung*/ re zhig de skor tshang ba'i lugs su byas nas/ slar yang yar lam byang kha brgyud nas 'ongs/ lar nged kyis chu lho byang 'di dag thags su btag pa la re re bzhin gyi lo rgyus smos rin mi chog lang yang mi lang*/ 'jag pa slob dpon bla ma lung rig pa'ang nged dang sdeb nas yod/ slar stag lung rin po che phebs phebs thub 'di khar chos zhu sogs la sdad/ jo nang pa'i bstan pa la mos zhen che ba rang yod 'di skabs nged rtag brtan du zhag 'ga' shas bsdad/ ngal gso tsam ma gtogs 'di byas med/ lo dus kyi 'khrid mo che 'jugs par nye bas/ dpal gyi ri khrod du phyin/ nyang stod nas mkhan chen kun dga' lung rig pa'i drung gis sbyor drug gi 'khrid yig la nyer mkho'i lhan thabs zhib pa cig dang*/ rgyud kyi spyi don zhig 'bri dgos gsung ba snga rol nas yod kyang*/ rang re dus rgyun du le lo rnam g.yeng gnyis dang 'grogs pas phyi bshol la song*/ 'di skabs khrid kyi lhan thabs de grub na da res bskur gsung ba 'dug kyang*/ de gong ma grub pas de lo 'khrid cig gnang rgyur 'dug pa la phan thogs par ma byung yang*/ de 'phral nas rtsom pa'i 'go btsugs te dus 'khrid kyi ngo sgang la grub tshogs che rab byung*/ sbyor drug jo lugs 'chad pa rnams la mkho bar 'ong ba yod/ ka bzhi sprul pa'i sku la'ang zur du chos ci rigs dang*/ sems phyogs kyi skor ngo sprod ci rigs kyang phul/ dus khrid kyang sngar rgyun ltar legs lam rgya che bar bshad/ de nas 'brug lo gsar ba'i dus thog yin/ stag lung nas zhabs drung rin po che yang 'di phyogs chos gsan pa la phebs pa'i dgongs brtad kyi bka' shog bsam 'grub rtser 'byor/

rtag brtan du sleb 'phral nas gdan 'dren pa gcig btang*/ 'khrid gtor sogs kyi thog tu phebs thub bam sems pa byung na'ang*/ ma phyogs hor gseb tu 'phrin las gsar skyes 'dras cung zad 'gyangs/ 'khrid gtor gyi gong tsam du 'bri mtshams nas rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba 'byor byung*/ sger du chos than thun 'dra yang tshugs/ khrid grol mtshams nas gser mdog can gyi khams pa 'dra dang*/ bsam sdings pa sogs 'ga' zhig la/ nai gu chos drug gi khrid cig kyang byas/ dpal 'khor lo chen po'i sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog zhig kyang brtsams/ stag lung rin po che yang bsam 'grub rtser phebs zin/ 'di phyogs phebs pa'i dus dang nye bar 'dug nas/ hor zla gnyis pa'i nyer bdun la rtag brtan du sleb/ grabs yul 'dra'i khungs nas/ rje ye shes drung la 'jigs byed skyo lugs kyi zhi drag gi dbang yongs rdzogs sogs chos bka' ci rigs pa byas/ hor zla gsum pa'i tshes dgu la dpal stag lung pa dpon slob rnams rtag brtan dam pa'i chos kyi gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal du phebs/ de nyin phebs spro gang bzab byas/ sang nyin tshes bcu la/ sku skyos tshul gyi nged la 'bul gnang rnams kyang mdzad/ de nyin ka chos 'brel thog ma tshe dpag med dkar po'i rjes gnang tsam phul nas/ tshes bcu gcig nas brtsams te chos bka' rnams grangs mang ba rang btsugs/ dgongs bzhed kyi gtso bo sbyor drug dang lam 'bras kyi skor sngar ma gsan 'dug pa dang*/ nai gu rags rim tsam gsan 'dug kyang*/ shangs chos yongs rdzogs cig dgos pa 'dug pa dang*/ gzhan dbang lung mang rab dang bcas pa dgos pa 'dug pas/ shangs chos yongs rdzogs dang*/ sbyor drug dang*/ lam 'bras gsum po tshugs pa dang*/ grol ba la dus snga phyi zhag ci rigs kyi khyad ma gtogs mnyam 'dzugs byas/ de yang shangs chos la rgyud sde lnga'i dbang chen mo dang*/ gzhung bka' nyer lnga dang*/

rnam 'joms gsang sgrub phyag rdor dza li ma sogs dbang bka' thor bu mang po dang*/ gser chos lnga'i khrid dang*/ 'khrid chung ba bdun/ su kha'i chos skor yongs rdzogs/ lung bka' sngar gsan pa rnams thog mtha' bar gsum ra dang*/ ma gsan pa'i lung rnams rdzogs par phul/ bde mchog lha lnga/ sgyu lus dbang mo che/ chos drug gzhung gi 'khrid rnams dpon slob byes pa rnams kyi steng du gzhan yang ci rigs dang bcas pa'i nyis brgya lhag tsam la dpal chen lha khang du bshad/ dus 'khor la rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun dang*/ dbang gong ma bzhi rnams byes pa dpon slob thams cad dang rtag brtan gyi grwa pa gsar pa'i rigs dus 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi dbang ma thob pa thams cad la byas/ sku dngos su grwa tshang gi slob dpon sogs phyag phyir yod pa la/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ gegs sel 'khrul 'khor ngo sprod rnam bzhi sogs mtha' rgyas rang du phul/ lam 'bras la gzhi byes 'dres pa'i zhu mkhan sum cu tsam yod/ rgyu dbang yab bka' yum bka' gnyis/ lam dbang dang*/ bdag med ma'i byin rlabs chen mo/ lam zab phyi nang*/ bir srung phyi nang*/ bla ma rin 'byung*/ brda chig brgyud/ rnam 'joms bir lugs/ brda don gsal ba sogs dbang byin brlabs kyi bka' phal cher yang grub/ lung bka' yig sna drug bcu dang*/ phra mo'i po ti brgyud pa'i rnam thar rnams rdzogs par song*/ lam skor phyi ma bdun gyi 'khrid ngag thog nas phul/ ind+ra bo dhi'i skor dang bcas pa brgyad char gyi lung dang*/ phyag chen yi ge med pa'i byin rlabs rnams kyang song*/ mtsho skyes lugs ḍoṃ bi lugs/ mtshon cha can/ dgra nag zhang lugs sogs dbang zur bka' dang*/ byin rlabs rjes gnang dang ma hā mā ya'i khrid sogs mang rab phul/ 'di ka'i ring la gser mdog can nas byon pa sogs bsnyain rdzogs sgrub mkhan yang mang du byung*/

sde srid kyi phyag nas sgrol ma gtso mo rkang gang tsam dang*/ 'khor 'jigs pa brgyad skyob dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma bskul byed ma'i sku gnyis sogs la gsung phebs ltar gzungs bzhugs rab gnas bzab ste byas/ chos lung byang rtse'i gnas mjal gyi dgongs bzhed dang bstun/ nged kyis kyang phyin/ chos lung du nag po rim bzhi/ dril bu rim lnga/ lū hi pa'i 'khrid/ gdan bzhi'i khrid/ lam 'bras dang 'brel bar grags pa'i rnal 'byor dbang bskur/ dpal mgon po'i rjes gnang*/ lung bka' mang po dang bcas pa phul/ phyi nang gi rten mjal thams cad kyang zhib mor mdzad/ yang zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la rtag brtan du 'khor/ gsang 'dus rim lnga mar lugs kyi 'khrid dang*/ rang re'i rtsom rnams kyi lung dang*/ dus 'khor sdom chen gyi dbang bka' rnams sku rkyang la phul zhing*/ dpon slob spyi la'ang rngog lugs kyi bsre 'pho lam dgu skor dang bcas pa'i mgyogs 'khrid dang*/ phyag g.yog dang grwa tshang ba rnams kyis nan chen po rang byas pa'i/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang stag lung ba'i lugs de khong tsho mang po cig la byed dgos byung*/ stag lung rin po ches nged la bstod pa bstan bzhugs kyi tshig tu spel ba cig kyang thugs rtsom mdzad/ gdan dang gnang sbyin sogs gnang ba'i brtan bzhugs legs lam che ba gnang*/ de rjes phar la lha dkar po gsum pa cig gi rjes gnang yang phul/ dpon slob kun la ci tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la gsol chas nyer mkho chibs dre'u sogs thams cad nas mthun rkyen 'joms pa yon bdag gi snyan dkrog mi dgos pa dang*/ slob dpon so so thams cad du gdab lan yang bzang bar phul bas dgyes nges shes pa byas so/ / de mtshams ka dpal stag lung pa dpon slob rnams kyang rim pas shar phyogs su phebs bzhud gnang song*/ de ltar zla ba phyed dang gsum du nye ba cigagazhi byes thams cad nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' bar byung*/

kho bo rang bzhin khams ngan cing*/ rlung khams kyis yang yang na yong ba yin kyang*/ de kha'i ring la khams kyang bzang ba rang byung*/ las 'brel rnam par dag cing dam gtsang ba'i rtags cig cis kyang yin pa 'duga'adi skabs kyang zhig gsos phran bu byed kyin yod/ de rjes mchod rten khang brtsegs ma che nges pa cig kyang bzhengs/ lo re bzhin gyi tsha tsha rnams bzhugs par byas/ 'chi bdag dbyug 'dzin gyi sgrol ma zhes kyang bya/ 'chi ba slu ba'i sgrol ljang gi gser sku mi tshad las che nges pa zhig bzhengs yod pa 'di yang snga ma yos lo'i nang du grub pa bsam pa yin kyang*/ bzo bo rnams zar du 'gro dgos byung bas cung zad 'gyangs/ sngar bzhengs pa'i bdud 'dul sgrol ma dang*/ rgyal ba tshe dpag med dang*/ yum chen mo dang*/ da res 'di rnams la g.yu phra mu tig rin po che'i rigs sogs/ lag na than thun gang yod rnams phul bas/ phra rgyan phun sum tshogs pa yod/ bzo bo lag bde shos rang mi 'dug kyang zhal ras mtshar zhing tshugs kyang bzang bar byung*/ 'di skabs sgrol ma'i rten sgrigs grub/

gzungs bzhugs dang nang gi rab gnas rnams thog mar byas/ rtag brtan tshogs pa la'angasdom chen gyi dbang dang*/ theg mchog dbu ma'i le'u lnga pa'i 'phros dang drug pa rnams rdzogs par bshad/ 'chi ba blu ba'i sgrol ma'i sku la dgos 'dod stsol ba'i sgrol mar mtshan gsol cing/ snga sor mgon po lcam dral gyi zab sku la/ rtag brtan gyi dge 'dun rnams la rten mjal tsam ma gtogs/ yongs la mjal kha gtong ba de brtag pa la ma chug pas bzhag pa yin/ skabs 'dir dgos 'dod stsol ba'i sgrol ma dang*/ mgon po'i zab sku'i rten mjal dus gcig tu byed pa dang lhan du/ sngar bzhin dga' ston skya ser gyi tshogs thams cad la bsgrubs/ lhun grub sgang pa bstan 'dzin de skabs sa skyar glo bur du 'das 'dugakho pa tsam la mngon spyod ni byed rin yang mi chogasngar khong ra'i sngos sngos tog tog rang gi zhen byed sa/ 'brug pa dang chos 'khor lhun po ba sogs kyis ni khong rang sdug dus phan bre gang yang ma thogs/ sngar thug pa cig kyang zhu ma myong ba'i brag stod pas sdug dus skyabs byas pa la drin log par gzhal ba'i la yog lo ma 'khor ba la byung ba de yin/ lar khong pa la nor chen po yod 'dug cing*/ shi rjes nor thams cad sa skya rang nas bzhes 'dug pas/ rgyu gang yin yang mi shes pa'i rigs gcig byung 'duganor la mig nyi shos 'di tsho ka zhed par gda'/ 'di skabs lcags zam pa rje drung rtogs ldan pa yang zas ngan byung nas gshegs pa'i bsngo rten yang 'byor/ de rjes hor zla bdun pa'i nang du/ sgrub gnas chen po'i bla brang rnying pa'i gdong de na thab tshang sogs khang pa skyal skyol 'jigs la khad du ma 'dug pa rnams/ thog mar gtor ma rgya cher btang nas sa gzhi thub phab/ der sa chog gzhung dang mthun par byas/ snga gong jo nang gi 'du khang la gtsang khang mi 'dug pas/ der lha khang bzhengs pa yin/ sgam po sprul sku lcam sring kyang phebs/

bzheng dgongs ltar shangs chos rags rim cha tshang dang*/ dbang rjes gnang 'ga' shas phul/ sa chog byed sa der 'du khang dang sbrel ba'i gtsang khang ka bzhi ma thog dpangs mtho nges dang*/ de'i steng du'ang de dang rgya khyon mnyam pa'i lha khang dang*/ 'du khang gi thig khang khor yug kyang phal cher spo dgos dang*/ 'du khang sgo'i bar mkhyams chen mo steng 'og dang bcas pa phyi'i rdo gcal/ pa ra rdo skas sogs dang bcas pa yod/ bsam gtan gling gi ltag tu yang lha khang ka bzhi ma/ steng 'og gnyis par 'khyams dang bcas pa grub pa la theg chen rtser ming btags/ gtsug lag khang chen mo'i gtsang khang steng 'og gi zhal ba tshun chod rten gtso'i sa khri dang bcas pa rnams hor zla dgu pa'i zla stod tshun la grub/ sngar sgrol ma'i sku bzhengs grub pa'i rjes thogs la ka thub pa'i dbang po'i sku brnyan yang bzhengs pa'i 'go brtsams pa lha khang grub mtshams de yang mi ring bar bzhengs grub nas/ zhag shas cig bgegs skrod dang bsrung ba byas nas/ bzhugs su gsol/ rtag brtan du dpal gur gyi mgon po lcam dral gyi 'cham sku yang bzhengs/ dpal ldan dakshad chen po'i 'khor tshogs 'cham pa'i gtor chen gyi nyin gting skyes nas chos mdzad ma mched kyang byon pa kho tsho mi ngo brgyud la chos skyong 'go ba yod zer ba'ang 'dra rung byung*/ gting skyes pa'i mi ngo lcam sring 'di pa yang yang phebs pa la byon res dgon yas mar 'di kun tu zhabs thog bzang nges pa star chags su mdzad/ 'di skabs byang ngam ring nas/ dpon sa sras yum dang*/ khyad par rje btsun ngag dbang drung bar skabs ma mjal bar yun ring rab song bas/ nges par mjal dgos 'dug gsung*/ zhal ngo dpon g.yog rnams kyang phebs byung*/ tshe dbang rjes gnang sogs 'ga' shas dang*/ nai gu chos drug dbang khrid cha tshang bshad/ dgon phu mda'i rten mjal rnams kyang zhib rgyas mdzad/ rje btsun ngag dbang drung yang shin tu thugs yid ches phar gyur/

rgyang tsam bzhugs nas zhal ngo dpon g.yog bying rnams slar yang phyogs thegs de mtshams hor zla bcu pa'i nyer lnga la/ gtsang khang gsar par thub pa'i dbang po'i sku brnyan/ rgya mtho bcu gsum gyi tshad gzungs bzhugs rten sgrigs sogs byas shing*/ de nyin nas ka gzung*/ rje ye shes rgya mtsho la dpal 'khor lo sdom pa rtsa ba'i rgyud chen po'i zhib bshad nges tig can rgyud dang grub thob kyi gzhung gi khung dang 'brel la/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gi snying po can/ byin rlabs kyi bka' babs dpag tu med pa'i mdzug khrid lag bcangs ma/ kun gyi spyod yul ma yin pa de'i 'go btsugs/ nyi ma gsum gyi khongs su zhal gser/ spyan 'byed tshun tshod rten gyi bya ba thams cad grub/ sngar gyi bdud 'dul sgrol ma sogs rnams la'ang*/ tsha gser la gser zho brgya skor re song*/ sku tshad che chung gi mang nyung phran tshegs re yod/ da res kyi ston pa'i sku brnyan 'di la nyis brgyar nye ba tsam song*/ nged kyi sngar bzhengs pa thams cad la sku'i rgyab mdun la khyad med 'bul ba dang*/ zhal ras sku gzugs kyi gtso bor 'dug pas/ sku lus bying las kyang tsha gser 'thug pa dang*/ de steng grang gser 'bul ba yin/ grang gser las tsha gser lnga 'dab drug 'dab kyi rgyu 'gro che bas/ zhal ras la grang gser 'bul ba'i rtsis kyi zangs dmar du 'jog pa'i srol zhig dus phyis phal cher la 'dug ste/ byas blo tsam gyi g.yo zol du 'dugakhag che shos la gal chung byas pa'i nyes pa cig kyang yong ba 'dugabyings dang 'dra ba zhig nams kyang byed dgos so/ / de 'phral rab gnas kyang tshar gnyis byas/ slar zla ba dkar ba'i skabs/ tshes bdun brgyad gnyis la rab gnas byed rgyu'i sta gon gyi nyin cho ga ma tshugs tsam la/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i thugs dam rten yin nges/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i dkyil thang cig ngam rings rje btsun drung gis nas nged ra'i lag tu phebs byung bas/

rab gnas kyang lū hi pa'i cho ga'i steng nas byas/ dngos gzhi'i nyin chos sde yang yar phebs/ dge 'dun dang sgrub sde skya ser shin tu tshogs che ba la/ dga' ston sbyin gtong rgya cher byas/ zla ba bzhi'i khungs su dge 'dun dang*/ skye bo'i tshogs thams cad la rab gnas dga' ston sbyin gtong rgya che ba lan gnyis la/ grabs shoms yun ring gi dka' las rang ma dgos/ nged bla chung yin te/ bla chen dang sde dpon tsho la bltas tsa na rgod bro mo'ang gda'o/ / lar ni zang zing la 'gangs tsam ci yod/ 'gangs med byas kyang thams cad de ka la rdib ni 'gro ba cig 'dugade bas phaṭa cig rgyag pa dga' ba yin/ nged ni rten bzhengs nas mi gzhan gyis snyan dar e 'bul bsams mig ci re ba ma byas/ rab gnas byas ma thag nas rang res snyan dar mang du sbron pa de/ gsar bzhengs kyi rten thams cad la yin/ 'dir yang sa rgyan gnam rgyan tsho yang cha 'grig grub/ snga phyi'i rten bzhengs 'di dag thams cad la rab gnas kyi rjes kyi skabs de kar/ bzo bo rnams la yon bcad thang ma las lhag pa re sprod pa/ nged kyi khyad chos yin/ khyad par snga phyir bzang sku bzhengs pa thams cad la/ bzo bo bal po rnams la gser rkyang ci 'byor dang*/ kha bskong yang ja gos dar sogs gser steng du 'gro nges shes pa kho na sbyin/ kha ma 'bud de 'dra ye ma myong*/ gzhan deng sang dad pas rten gsum gzhong mkhan ci rigs ni los kyang yod yong*/ spyir ni rten gsum bzhengs mkhan shin tu nyung*/ yo byad phal cher ja chang bza' btung la rdib/ pho rgyan mo rgyan 'cho zer nas nor grul btub rnams grul ma btub la gtong*/ gos bsnal ma khra chem chem gsar gsar re la snying por 'dzin/ btsun pa'i nor rnams mi nag pa la rdib/ mi nag pa dang bla ma'i nor rnams sdug 'dre la rdib/ yo bsngo nas dmyal ba dang yi dwags la rdib pa'i le'u cig gda'/ chos brgyad kyis rten gsum than thun gzhong na yang*/

snyom chung gi rigs la gleng brjod byed thes mi 'dugardzun g.yo sgyu than thun la lhus blangs pa cig ka yod srid kyang*/ rang la med tsa na de las thabs mi gda'/ 'ga' zhig dgon sde ga ge mor je ge cig gzhong rgyu yin zer ba'i snyad kyis sde dpon bskul ba'i tsha 'jun dbang che byas te/ tshong 'dus so so'i gser sdom/ zangs sdom/ rin ma sprad par dbang che byas 'phrogam rabs 'brang ma gtsang gi spyod pa mngon sum du bstan pa la/ kha tho nam mkha' la 'phyar/ las ngan bya byed cig gis rang dang yon bdag sde dpon gnyis kar la/ 'phrog 'joms kyi sdig pas phyi ma phung*/ mi kha ngan pa bsdus pas 'dir phung*/ mig ltos ngan pa de btsun pas bslabs phyin/ 'jig rten pa rnams los kyang byed de/ tshong zong sdom pa dang 'phrog tshod byed pa'i mig ltos ngan pa 'di phyis tshugs pa yin/ bzo bo sogs kyang rang gi g.yog gam grwa rigs sam/ phyogs zhen can yin na der zad/ de min rang gi lag nas 'gro gang chung rang byed/ 'di la yon bdag ga ge mos yon rdzongs byas/ che ge mos phogs rgyab 'di ka rang nas rdo la 'chil ma yang rgyag ma dgos zer gin rang gis dge ba ci yang ma byas pa de skyon 'ba' zhig tu 'dug pa la/ de shugs che che mo/ dbang che che mo/ gzhan la dbang 'dus 'dus mo'i rbad shod kyi khungs kyis thams cad la ngom ngom byed/ gzhan gyis byas nas rang gi ngo so byed don mi gda' ba/ 'dug ni blun rtags kyi gtam du 'dug ste/ mi phal thams cad khas drag drag dang ser sna la dga' bas/ glen pa rnams kyi rne mchog tu de 'dzul ba cig kyang gda'/ ji skad du/ gang phyir 'jig rten skyon la dga'/ / skyon yang yon tan ltar mthong nas/ zhes pa de dngos su byon/ 'phrog 'joms dang gzhan bskul ba 'ba' zhig la dam pa'i spyod par byed pa yang ya mtshan/ nor po che cig rang nor bsdams nas/ nor med tshun chod la slong mo byed pa 'di yang ya mtshan/

ltogs bla rgya che la rnam grangs mang zhing mchu rno ba la mnyam pa nyid zer ba 'di yang ya mtshan/ nyin mtshan chos brgyad dang chags sdang 'ba' zhig gis dus 'das nas 'brel tshad don ldan yin zer ba 'di yang ya mtshan no/ / ya mtshan can yin zer yang zer te/ ya mtshan can dgu bcu rtsa drug rang du 'dug go / 'di rnams drang por smras pa yin/ snying la phog na gnong yod pa yin/ drang gtam smras pa la mi dga' zol zol la dga' ba de bar chad kyis khyer ba yin/ go bar byos la rang rang gi sna rtse la 'dzug mo tshugs shigade nas mi ring bar dpal ldan sham bha la gnyis pa'i lo dus kyi nyams khrid kyang tshugs/ 'khrid gsar ba phyogs kyi grwa rgyun shin tu mang bar byus/ ngam ring nas lcam drung gis yang dam po mdzad 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud bshad kyang*/ 'tshub ltas dang cho 'phrul che se ba'i ngang nas bshad pa 'phel ba de ka byas/ dam po bdun rting ma grol du nye ba la/ sog po yongs sho ba'i rgyal po das bying gi bu bla ma skyabs cho khur thas chi sog yul sdings nas a chen thang du 'byor nas lo tsam song ba'i skabs yin pa 'dugakhong gi tha gu sna cig nged la yi ge dang yig rten 'bul ba cung zad dang bcas pa skyel bar byung*/ sne sbyor stag lung nas 'bul dpon cig kyang 'dugade tsho dang lhan du rang re'i slob rigs rag phrom bla ma shes rab chos 'phel dang*/ kha sog gi mi bzang ba dur khas dge log kun dga' bkra shis sogs 'byor zhing*/ sog po'i grwa rigs kyang nyi shu rtsa 'dren 'dir 'byor/ tha gu sna dbus gtsang la mi snar yong rigs su 'dug pas/ chos 'brel 'dra zhus nas/ yig lan khyer te 'phral du song*/ gzhan thams cad 'khrid gtor gyi ring la bsdad/ sog po'i grwa rigs rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sgrub dgos rnams bsgrubs/ zhor la bsgrub mkhan dang bcas pas/ rab byung ba dang snyen rdzogs pa mang par byung*/ de rjes 'dir sog ban slob gnyer ba mang dag bsdad song zhing*/

ba dur kha sogs 'gro 'os rnams logasbrul lo hor zla dang po'i yar ngo'i nang du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud bshad kyang bar chad med par mthar phyin/ nged kyis dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang khrid sna tshogs pa ni grangs med cig bgyis/ skyed rdzogs kyi bshad pa'ang ci rigs pa byas/ snga sor rang lo nyer lnga pa'i thog tu tshar gcig spungs bshad du byas nas yongs su rdzogs pa de yang bkas gnang ba'i mtshan rtags cung zad byung nas byas pa yin/ bshad pa yang spungs pa dang nyan pa po blo zhan pas ngag sgros zin pa ni ma byung*/ de rjes grwa thang bla chen rin po che la thob chos kyi rgyud pa'i khyad snga nas/ bshad tshoms bsdus tsam/ le'u'i sa khongs bcad tsam/ zhag lnga la rdzogs pa cig byas/ de 'dra'i rigs can gzhan yang 'ga' re yod/ de min zhib bshad rgyas pa 'di rtag brtan thebs pa'i rjes tshun chod byed 'dod chen po byung yang*/ bka' gnyan pa'i stabs kyis lag tu ma longs/ 'di res legs pa'i mtshan ma cung zad byung nas bshad pa yin/ skye bo mang po la ma bshad cing*/ phyed tsam song song du gang yin yang gsangs/ ngag sgros sogs kyang yi ger thebs pa'i rjes can tu byung*/ rgyud kyi dbu zhabs thams cad zab don dang 'brel pa'i 'chad tshul/ rgyud rgyal po lta bur bshad pa'am slob bshad snying gi thig le de yin/ 'di la sdoms drug gi snying po bsdus pa'i gzhung de med kha med cig lags/ rdo rje phag mo'i bstod pa sgyu 'phrul chen mo de yang kha skongs su nges par dgos pa cig yin/ zla ba gnyis pa'i nang du rtag brtan du chos sde'i spyi chos su snga phyir rim can du/ rjes gnang byin rlabs mang po dang*/ theg chen gyi lam rim zab la rgya che ba gong na med par 'dug pas/ theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan gyi zab bshad 'dug khrid ngo sprod 'dzug tshugs dang bcas pa tshugs par byas/ 'di skabs stag lung nas sog yul du phyin pa'i 'bul dpon gcod pa bla ma dang*/

sog yul gyi nang nas shin tu thag ring ba/ khor chen nas skyes yin pa la/ a pa khas kyi rgyal po'i mchod gnas sog po dge slong cig sogs kyang 'byor/ dge slong gis mang ja bdun sbrel rgyab/ gzhan yang khong de rnams kyis so so nas phu mdar mang ja bsnyen bkur bsngo rten bzang bar bsgrubs/ a pa khas kyi rgyal pos yig ge 'bul rten bzang ba dang bcas pa byung*/ khong tshos tshogs chos sger chos gnyis kar zhus/ khyad par 'khor lo sdom pa nag po pa'i dbang bskur cig byed dgos byung*/ rgyal po la'ang yig lan byin rlabs rten sogs bskur/ de nas a ma drung shin tu bsnyung ba'i stabs/ chos mtshams bzhag ste zla ba gsum pa'i nyer gcig la jo nang du phyin/ sku shin tu ltem par 'dug na'ang thugs rig dwangs bar 'dug cing*/ babs kyi bgres nad lta bur 'dugasku mthar thon rang mi yong ba 'dug na'ang*/ rkyen sku grib cig gis blangs 'dug pas rnam 'joms kyi bkru chab cig phul/

de rjes nyi ma gnyis bsnyungs gzhi rang ni chung ngu mi 'gro 'dug na'ang*/ thugs rig dwangs pas gsung gleng zhib par gnang thub/ de thub phyi ru bzhugs nyi la'ang phebs/ de nas gzims chung du bzhugs pa grag zhus/ sku stobs zad pa'i rnam pas gsung gleng yang re re tsam ma gtogs gnang mi thub/ nyer lnga'i snga dro'i cha la sku 'das song*/ de ma thag rang res sku spur yi drung du/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod byas shing*/ zhus 'bul bar du rang res cho ga bzlas brjod mang rab dang bcas pa 'chag med bsgrubs/ rtag brtan tshogs pas mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga dang*/ sgrub sde chen pos rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i cho gas thugs dam bskul bar mdzad/ zhag gsum dang zhus 'bul gyi skabs su/ tsam 'bo dang*/ nas 'gyed sogs zhabs tog bzang ba dang*/ lha khang rnams su mchod pa rgyas par 'bul ba dang*/ zhag gnyis nas thugs dam grol/ gnam gang bar du zhus 'bul 'gyangs kyang sku spur mdangs dkar zhigadri mi zhim ba cung zad kyang med pa dang*/ dbu gtsug 'phar ba sogs ngo mtshar che bar byung*/ sku tshigs khongs su stod smad lho byang gi dgon pa brgya lhag nges la/ mang ja 'gyed bcas re song*/ thag nye ba rnams la nas 'gyed re yang yod/ sku sger du/ sku chas 'gangs che ba rang ni med/ gang yod la ni za 'dre las ngan gyi bskos ba po gda'/ dgongs rdzogs gang yod rang res sgrub pa las 'os yod kyang ci yod/ 'on kyang blo non pa rang da gong ma grub rung dkyus dang mthun pa las mi zhan tsam 'grub/ mkhan chen kun dga' lung rig drung gis/ khong rang gi yab gzhis rong thog par/ dpal jo nang pa'i srol kha'i dgon gnas che thebs chung thebs gang ltar 'dra ba'i dgongs pas dgon gnas de yos 'brug tsho la 'debs pa gnang ba yin/ gtso bor sde srid dang*/ dgos su rin spungs nas mthun rkyen phra mo tsam mdzad/ da res lo 'di la rtag brtan nas lha bris pa phyin pa'i da lta 'dri bzhin pa'i skabs yin/

sa ga'i zla ba la/ sgrub mchod kyi sgang der/ 'bras spungs su mtshams bsdams te/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub pa cig kyang byas/ zhag bdun song mtshams lde gu'i skabs/ gung thun grol/ dgongs thun ma tshugs pa'i thun mtshams cig la/ dam rdzas la sgra chen po cig kyang byung*/ nang bar ril bu sbril khar bltas pas/ snod gzhan rnams su'ang cung zad dang*/ thod pa gnyis su bdud rtsi mang du babs 'dugamatshan ldan thod pa cig na bdud rtsi dmar po shas che ba dang*/ cig tu bdud rtsi dkar po shas che ba'i phul gang tsam re/ dam rdzas la thogs med du song nas/ gting na 'khyil ba'i rnam par 'dugaril bu sgril mkhan dge slong bzang po dge 'dun sogs la bstan yang bstan/ ril bu'i dus su 'phel yang che ba tsam byung*/ da res kyi sgrub pa 'di la/ dam rdzas tshogs kyang che zhing*/ bshad tshod kyi sman sna thams cad kyang shin tu 'dzom pa dang*/ dam rdzas rnam pa bcu'i cha shas dngos su'ang yod cing bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dam rdzas kyi rta yang 'dzom po rang byung*/ chos rgyud sna tshogs pa'i byin rlabs rten ni ngo ti de bzang po yin srid kyang*/ brgyud pa'i sel du 'gro gsung nas/ bsre bar mi mdzad pa bla ma gong ma rgyud pa nas brgyud pa'i myong grub yin/ lo rgyus kyang mang du gda'o/ / de mtshams nas a ma sku gshegs de'i nang rten du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma cigam rang gi thugs gtad kyang yin pas/ sku 'dra bzhengs par bsam ste/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa'i gser sku bzhengs pa'i 'go brtsams so/ / de nas chos bshad na phan yon che bar 'dug nas/ yang sngar gyi 'phros las/ theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan gyi bshad pa dang*/ dbang bka' byin rlabs rnams btsugs/ chos thun che ba rang re bshad cing*/ dbang byin rlabs rnams kyang ngo mtshar che mod/ skyo sangs tsam nyan spro ba'i phyir yin/

chos kyi gtso bo ni mdo sde rgyan nyid yin/ chos kyang 'phel ba rang byung zhing*/ snga dro khams ngan pa rlung khams kyis na ba la yang*/ tshogs chos 'chad pa'i 'go brtsams pa nas/ chos kyi ring la na ba med cing lus nyams bzang ba/ skad kyang 'don bde ba yod zhing*/ de kha'i rgyun la lan 'ga' re chos grol nas kyang*/ na ba de sangs pa mang du byung*/ skabs mtshams nas ri khrod chen por na nang gi las 'phro la/ gtsang khang chen mo'i thigs khang zhal ba dang bcas pa dang*/ bsam gtan gling gi theg chen rtse'i yang thigs khang khang g.yog sogs kyi mthar 'don dang*/ gzhan yang zhig gsos ci rigs pa byed du bcug pa rnams grub/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes gsum yan la/ mdo sde rgyan gyi thabs dang ldan pa'i las yan chad song nas/ phar phyin le'u'i dbu tshugs tsam la re zhig chos mtshams byas/ de rjes phu ru gtor ma rgya cher tsam btang nas/ bla brang gong gi rgyun dra ka dgu sogs kun mkhyen chen po'i dus kyi gzims khang yin nges su 'dug pas/ ka dgu gzims chung dang bcas pa rnams la bshig ral ni ma byas/ shin tu khogs 'dug pas brtan byed kyi thabs dang*/ gzhan rnams la zhig gsos dgos pa rnams dang*/ bla brang byang rtsa ba nas 'chos dgos pa yang grub/ lha khang bde ba can gyi zhig gsos 'phro ma lus pa de la slar yang mchod khang rnying pa la brtan byed dang khang g.yog rnying pa hrul po de rtsa ba nas bshigalha khang gsar ba steng 'og gnyis kyang brtsigs/ khang g.yog de rnying pa'i dus na nyis thog tu 'dug kyang*/ da res gsum thog legs par khel/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu la ras gzhi la skar 'dzin tsam byas te/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zab sku bzhengs pa'i 'go btsugs/ theg chen rtse na 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku brnyan yang bzhengs bzhin pa yin/ yos lo'i gzhug nas brtsams te/ grub thob brgyad cu'i thang chen gyi 'go brtsams/ 'brug lo'i nang du grub cing*/

thang kha chen mo nyi shu rtsa dgu yod/ rdo rje gdan pas mdzad par brdzus pa'i stod pa'i lugs de snga phyi kun tu dar bar 'dug kyang*/ nor 'khrul shin tu che ba yin/ grub thob brgyad cu'i do ha/ rgya gar gyi grub thob dpa' bo 'od gsal gyis bsdus pa 'di rtsa bar bzhag pa'i grub brgya'i dbang bka' da lta'i bar du'ang rgyun ma chad par yod pa 'di/ khungs ma yin pas da res kyang de'i lugs su bris/ 'brug lo'i nang du sbyor drug brgyud pa'i thang mo che bcu gcig dang*/ da lo de 'phros nye brgyud kyi thang ka gnyis te thang mo che bcu gsum bzhengs/ gzhan khro bo'i rgyal po'i thang kha lnga sogs bzhengs te/ de rnams kyi gong gsham zhal khebs sogs cha lag rnams kyang grub/ 'brug lo'i gzhug nas brtsams te thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug gi thang kha thog tshad ma nyi shu rtsa gcig yod pa zhig da lta bzhengs bzhin pa'i skabs yin/ lcags mo phag lo nas gzungs/ sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo la char skyobs kyi na bza' phul/ de yang na bza' re la nam thang bzang ba brgya bud re dgos/ char che chung dang bstun pa'i lo gnangs cags bzhes bcags la gsar pa re spos/ [de ]dgong lo bcu dgu song*/ phyogs bzhir dus bzang re bzhin mar me 'bul ba'i kong bu chen po re yang phul/ rtag brtan du lo dus lo dus la dge slong bsnyen par rdzogs pa byed pa yang*/ sum cu bzhi bcu skor gyi gras re byung ba'ang lan mang*/ thor bu pa la rtsis btab med/ snga phyir gar chas 'cham chas kyi rigs dang*/ snam sbyar gyi rigs spyi la sbyar ba dang*/ dgon lag la song ba dang*/ dgos dgos su sbyin pa sogs la ni rtsis btab med/ dang po snga mo zhig rnga 'dra dgos par byung nas/ byang nas zhabs drung de dang*/ gtsang zhabs drung de nyid du rnga 'dra dgos tshul zhus pas/ de 'phral yas mar gnyis ga nas rnga drug bdun re gnang*/ gtsang nas slar yang rnga bcos nas yod phebs/

de 'phral rnga mang po rang 'tsho ba mdzad na'ang*/ bcos grub nas gzhan la 'khogs te/ 'dir cig kyang ma byung*/ gzug po pa chen mos yong rgyu'i khungs cig yod pa'ang de kha 'dra ba rang byung*/ phyis 'byung rang re'i khul na rnga bzo shes mkhas pa rang byung nas/ gang 'dod bcos chog pa byung*/ mi la re ba ma che lha la gsol ba thob kyi dper brjod de 'dir yang byung ngo*/ / yang snga sor mi cig gis spar rkos bslabs/ de nas rim gyis 'di rang tu 'phel te da lta gsung rab rko mkhan gyi spar mkhan mang po yod pa rnams kyang*/ lag ma stongs par spar rko bzhin pa dang*/ de tsho la dpon g.yog gi 'du shes dang dbang che'i spyod pa ma byas par/ rgyun gyi phogs/ skabs skabs kyi ston mo/ lag rjes che ba re tsam grub pa la/ mi rer khal bdun cu brgyad bcu'i rtsis kyi yon sogs kyang mtha' khyab tu byas/ des mtshon pa chos sde'i rgyun gyi yig mkhan rnams kyang dus 'khor yug tu yi ge 'bri ba dang*/ lha bris pa mang dus la nges pa med/ nyung dus kyang bco lnga las mi nyung bas/ rtag tu ri mo 'bri ba la yang*/ mthun rkyen dang yon sogs gang la gang 'dod kyi snga ma rnams las mi zhan pa byas/ spros bral steng phyogs kyi dge sbyor la ni/ rnam 'gyur gang yang mi yong ba 'dra cig 'dugayon tan sna tshogs skye ba'i nyams la ni/ tshogs kyi sgo re re bsags pas gong nas gong du 'phel bar myong bas grub pa yin/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ / thugs rje chen po khyed/ / sdig can yongs la gzigs/ / ngan 'gro'i gnas las drongs/ /mi nag tha shal tsho/ / chos pa'i gzugs su rdzus/ / rgyud ngan 'dul bar zhu/ / lam sna thar par drongs/ / zhi ba'i 'dul lugs yin/ / a ho a ho/ gsang ba'i bdag po khong*/ / rdo rje 'bar ba thogs/ / snang srid g.yo zhing 'gul/ / dam nyams snying khrag gsol/ / sdig can nyal thag gcod/ / bdud dpung phyogs bcur 'thor/

/ gnam sa yo ru log/ gad med g.yang med 'khrugs/ / drag po'i 'dul tshul yin/ / a re a re/ zhi drag spyod pa gnyis po de/ / 'gal lam mi 'gal yag po ltos/ / 'gal lo snyam na glen pa yin/ / dgag dgos mi shes mkhas pa mtshar/ / bdag rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha 'di/ la la snyam na blun po ma sbyangs pa cig yin no snyam/ la la snyam na mkhas po chos shes pa cig yin nam snyam/ la la zer na rtog ge mgo mkhregs po zhig 'dug zer/ la la zer na 'khrul zhig lhod grol ba zhig 'dug zer/ kha cig gis bltas na grub mtha' phyogs med pa cig tu gda' skad/ kha cig gis bltas na phyogs zhen gting 'dzugs pa cig gda' skad/ ༵'ga' zhig ltar na tho co chos 'gal ngan pa rtsub bor byed/ 'ga' zhig ltar na rnam dkar dge bas dus 'da' ba cig tu byed/ gzhan 'ga' zer na chags sdang can phal pa cig yod skad/ gzhan 'ga' zer na grub pa'i dbang phyug cig yod skad/ la la zer na lta spyod ngan pa cig 'dug zer/ la la zer na gnas lugs mngon sum du gzigs pa cig 'dug zer/ la la zer na bsam ngan 'jig rten pa cig 'dug zer/ la la zer na chos pa'i yang rtse gcig 'dug zer/ la las ni bdud mngon sum par mthong*/ la las ni sangs rgyas mngon sum par mthong*/ la las ni lung bstan ngan pa rgyag/ la las ni lung bstan bzang po dang bstod ra byed/ thams cad kha mi mthun par ya re ma re mang lugs 'dis/ mi dkyus ma dri ma ching nge nyal mkhan cig rang ni min par thag chod/ sus kyang nyams go mi non lugs 'di la dpags na/ rnam pa thams cad pa zhes pa de yin nyen gda'/ thabs kyi spyod pas sems can don/ / byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ / sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs par mdzod/ / ces bshad pa de yang yong la khad do/ / da lta dpag tshad brgya tshun chod kyi thog phyi 'di na bdag gi gnas tshul dang mtshan nyid shes pa'i mi gcig su yang yod yod mi 'dra/ yang yod shas kyang che/

zab zom yar yor rdzang rdzong sgra sgrog 'di tsho phal che ba 'di ni/ nged kyis khong tsho'i gnas tshul go zhing*/ nyams 'og tu chud pa rkyang ka 'dug go / ha ha he he phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bhyoḥhūṃ/ da ni sngar gyi 'phros bshad na/ sbrul lo 'di kha'i 'go la/ zhabs drung rgyal bu 'di yang sku 'khrungs/ de kha'i mtshan dgos gsung ba byung bas/ kun dga' dbang chen dpal 'bar du mtshan btags/ da dung ming de kha gnas na/ byin rlabs kyi 'jug pa re gnas pa yin/ ji ltar mdzad ni mi shes so/ / sprul lo de kha'i 'phros la/ ri khrod chen por dri gtsang khang la/ dus 'khor bde mchog sogs sngags sku'i logs ris dang*/ steng khang du bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi gyang ris shing rtsi dang bcas pa kun kyang legs par grub pas bag chags par byung*/ badzra yo gi ni'i zab sku sogs sngar bshad pa'i rten bzheng 'phro rnams mthar phyin/ jo nang gi lha khang bde ba can du/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi sku brnyan skya bzo tsam grub pa yin/ 'di skabs yang ri bla ma dang*/ sde pa gtsang pa khrung khrung dkar la gzhug rtse nag pa'i skabs de yin/ re 'ga' ha cang nye rang grags/ re ha cang rang yang 'khon tshabs che grags phaṭa brtad pa ci yod/ lo 'di'i dpyid ka'i skabs shig ni yin/ zla tshes gang yin brjed gda'/ nub cig rmi lam na/ tshogs khang rnying pa cig tu/ nged lho skya nas kha byang la bstad 'dugashar gyi ga star zhig gi bar na rje karma pa yab sras gnyis 'ja' gdan cig la bzhugs 'dugade 'phral phyag g.yog 'ga' byung nas da 'byon ran 'dug zer/ dpon slob thams cad phyi la thegs song*/ de mtshams zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul sku rang chibs pa mgyogs po cig dang bcas/ go chas gyon pa 'ga' zhig gis chibs sna byas spyan drangs te/ lung pa de'i 'phred bcad nas/ lho phyogs cig gi la chen po gsum brgal nas phebs song ba zhig byung*/

mi ring bar lho phyogs nas lho phyogs su phebs pa'i rkyen gyis/ sku thim 'gro ba'i ltas su 'dug snyam pa gcig de 'dus ka byung*/ don la yang yin pa 'dugade skabs rten 'brel bzlog thabs dmigs gsal 'dra mdzad na/ sku dog sel ba la dka' tshegs chen po rang med rigs su 'dug na'ang*/ phyag g.yog mang po zhig dang*/ gtsang phyogs kyi khrims sa na sdod pa'i phyogs gtogs phal cher zhig/ nged la mi gnod 'drer 'dzin byed kyin 'dug pas/ ci dgongs kyang mi shes/ rgyal kha blon bsgyur gyi rnam pa yod dam sems/ zhu bar ni ma spobs so/ / skyes bu chen po kun la'ang tshul ston ni yin pa gzhir bcas/ sku gzhogs na nye ba tshos gang smras kyi zhu dbang du 'gro ba cig yong gin 'dug pa de kun la gsal ba de lags mod/ lo 'di'i ston ka nged ni 'bod mi nan can gnang ba la brten nas bsam rtser khor tsam phyin/ stag lo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rig pa 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor rdib pa'i ltas kyi don 'go ma tsho shar 'duga'adi skabs rkyen sel dbang chos sngar khyud ltar phul/

rgyal bu yum sras la rang tshe bka' sogs mang du phul/ zha lu ri phug pa'i dbu mdzad chen mo sogs 'ga' zhig la/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung gi lung 'dra ma klags/ thar pa'i grwa pa rnams la blo sbyong gi 'khrid/ rjes gnang zur bka' mang rab/ bla ma lnga bcu pa dang rtsa ltung gi bshad pa sogs/ dam tshig gi chos skor 'dra bshad/ mal gro 'chad ka ba'i bka' bcu pa zhig gis bskul nas/ der 'tshogs thams cad la sgrol ma nyer gcig nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi dbang lung rnams byas/ ngam ring nas rje btsun ma'i drung gis spangs lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe 'phreng ba skor gsum sogs rgya dpe 'ga' shas gnang nas/ sde srid du zhu sna tsam dgos tshul gyi don la/ sde srid rang du zhu rten phul ba'i yong sgo yod tsam gyis cha mchod gzhis gang 'os cig zhu bzhed du 'dugasde srid nas snga ma gang 'os cig gnang gsung ba'i zhal bzhis byung na'ang*/ ngam ring nas yum sras tshos/ de la 'gal rkyen gyi mi ched bstad btang*/ rjes la gshor kha phran tshegs yong gsung ba/ ma gtogs don 'grub pa ma byung*/ khong rang yum sras kyis skyong ba'i sa cha nas gcod rgyu ni min/ sde pa gzhung gi sa nas zhu ba la/ dgag pa mi dgos pa 'dug ste/ yon tan gyi dud pa gtong rgyu med pa der gda'/ snye thang gser khang nas 'brug 'brug dang*/ bde skyid nas sras po gzhon pa la ngo chen nan chags zhus pas/ btson nas thon/ chos sgor bcug/ sde srid kyi mjal kha byung yangs par khrol ba yin/ de lo yan la thar pa'i gtsang khang ma gtogs pa'i shing rtsi logs ris rnams grub mtshams su 'dug pas/ khong tshos rab gnas la yong dgos tshul dang*/ sde srid nas kyang rgyab skyor gyi bka' bkod tsam byung*/ khri khang brgyud nas/ dpal thar ba bde chen rab brtan gling du phyin/ yang ri drung pa kun dga' ba gshegs pa'i nged la bsngo rten dang thar par mang ja sogs byung*/

phar yang de mthun gyi mang ja dang 'dab lan byas/ khong pa nged kyi slob rigs kyang yin/ hor zla dgu pa'i yar ngo'i skabs der/ rab gnas mtha' rgyas su byas/ nyi khang dwangs shing 'ja' 'od sogs rten 'brel legs par byung*/ sems bskyed sogs tshogs chos kyi rten 'brel yang byas/ zhag shas bsdad/ sde pa gzhung nas mang ja bsngo rten sogs ni gnang*/ gzhan 'phral dgos rnams thar pa ba rang gis sbyar ba yin/ mkhan chen kun dga' lung rig pa yang nged dang 'phrad pa dang thar pa'i rten mjal la phebs/ 'bod mi nan chags byung zhing sa thag nye ba'i stabs/ 'dol byung du'ang khor tsam phyin/ zhal ngo rnams la rkyen sel dang*/ mi dmangs la tshe dbangasogs sngar khyud ltar byas/ chos lung tshogs nas mkhar chen khri thog pa yang nged 'phrad par phebs byung*/ sngar nas kyang chos 'brel yod cing 'di ris kyang chos 'brel 'ga' re gsan song*/ gzhan yang nyang stod phyogs nas 'phrad mkhan mang bar byung*/ tshur lam yang thar pa gling du lcags mal zhig bsdad/ rang re'i lag nas snga phyir mang ja 'gyed chas spyi rdzas sogs gang grag sbyar/ thar pa nas yongs nas tshong 'dus su sleb pa'i nyin/ cung khri'i mkhar pa la ngam ring yum sras kyis bka' bkyon byung*/ gzhis thams cad rtsis zer nas khong tsho'i rgad po rang dang bu btsun gzugs de sleb byung*/ 'di'i khungs bshad na/ khri mkhar ba 'di tsho dang snga gong nged tsho 'gras 'dris gnyis ka med/ byang ba rang la ni zhen can rang yin/ bla ma snye mo ba dkon mchog legs ldan zer ba'i dpon sa mnga' bdag ma yum sras rang gi bsrung 'khor ba yang yin/ mthu pa yang yin gtor dbang 'dra yang byed mkhan gyi bla ma yang yin/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa rang gi gshin rje tshe bdag dngos yin zer/ deng tshang gi smon gro dpon drung yab yum tsho'i yang mthu bzlog gi rtsa ba'i bla ma bcol ba cig gdoga.ang yig pa sangs ma rgyas nye gnas sangs rgyas ba'i ldaibs lnga drug tsam yod pa'i gcig yin/

de dang khong tsho phyogs cig yin pas/ deng phyogs dang 'brel pa ye med/ ngam ring yum sras tsho rang gis phyi thag gis skyong dgos cig ni yin par 'dugaphyis khong tsho'i chos mdzad bo dong brang byang ba'i bla ma de/ grwa sa yangs can pa yin/ bla ma snye mo ba dang*/ rgyal po stag gsham pa sogs kyi phyag phyi la bsdad kyang*/ sa skya ba dang*/ rnying ma'i bla ma rnams la ngo sprod ma byung zer nas/ sems ngo sprod pa'i chos dgos zhes dngos brgyud du ma nas nan chags byung ba ltar/ nged kyis kyang khong la chos drug cig kyang bshad/ gtso bor phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod kyang 'thems par byas/ sbyor drug kyang zhus/ sems la phan par byung zer/ phyis rting khong rang 'da' khar/ khong rang gis 'dzin bdag rang dbang can gzhan dang 'khris med ja jo sgam sgum gyi dgon pa cig yod pa de nged la 'bul ba dang*/ byang bu gcog pa yang nged la phul zer ba'i kha chems bzhag 'dugashul ma tshos kyang de kha bzhin byed rtsis byas pa ka yin/ ngam ring rang nas ni/ snga sor dam sel sa mun rub pa lta bu yin pa la/ phyis rting da lta'i yum sras gnyis rang la bshags pa blangs/ lugs legs pa'i khungs byas/ byang pa rang la snga phyir kham mchu thag thug byung ba kun la'ang nged kyis phan thogs su 'gyur nges shes pa byung*/ khyad par du yang lcam drung rang bsam 'grub rtser yang yang phebs pa kun la/ 'dre gdon gyi gtser ba'i snyung ba kho na dang bskras las lhung ba dang*/ rlung pos bskyod nas rgya sgo'i bar du gcer la khad pa sogs mi 'tshams pa 'ba' zhig byung*/ ngam ring rang du bzhugs dus kyang*/ yum sras gnyis ka phyag g.yog 'ga' re dang bcas pa la'ang*/ rgyal zil btsan zil gyes dran med du 'bog pa yang yang byung ba ma sbas yongs la grags pa de yin/ de la phan thabs yag pos yong ngas byas kyis zer ba nged kyis phar zhus pa med/ khong rang dpon g.yog phal cher 'dus pa'i gros la bsrung 'khor khyad dang*/

gnas bzang ba'i stabs ri khrod chen por bsnyen pa zhig mdzad na legs zer ba gros mthun 'dug pa/ lar nas dus phyis khrom la grags pa'i skad cha kun gsang gsang byed pa'i srol cig 'dug pas/ de bzhin gsang kyin yod na ma gtogs de dus tshang ma la rgyus yod pa de ka lags/ de mthun lcam drung rang jo nang du phebs/ rta mgrin gyi bsnyen pa thung tsam yang mdzad/ khyad par can du sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i 'khrid grar zhugs pas/ de phyin chad gnod byed zhud kha de rtsa ba nas chogs pa yin kyang*/ de rjes lo 'khor mi 'khor la ka phan 'dogs dang drin thams cad brjed/ mgo nag gi dad pa kha dang*/ nya ma'i dad pa 'dom kyi dpes mi ngan 'dra'i ngag la nyan te/ dam nyams nag sang sang ba/ rdo rje'i dmyal ba'i gting rdo de mdzad snying 'dod pa'i snyad/ khri mkhar bas byang pa la blo log byas zer nas bcom khyer la btang ba de ka yin/ mgon po ber nag can la 'jol ber nag po dgu brtsegs yod zer ba ni thos/ dam nyams nag po dgu brtsegs yong ba 'di 'dra ni/ khong ngam ring dpon g.yog tsho la ma gtogs gzhan su la'ang yod skad ma thos so/ / de skabs nged la ni 'di byed rang zhig med/ phyis khrims sar gtugs 'dug pas/ khri mkhar ba la rang gnas byung 'duga'aphros don bzhad gad bro mo de 'dra gdog lags/ da ni dkyus la 'jug ste/ tshong 'dus su gzims dpon lhun grub snga mo nas nged la blo gtad pa yin/ khong 'das pa'i shul rgya che rab yod pa rnams thar par kun mkhyen chen po'i drug mchod kyi thebs la sbyar/ thog ma lo gcig tsam gyi rtsis kyi ja yang sprad pa yin/ de nas chu mig tu zhag mal gcig byas/ gtsug lag khang mjal du phyin dus/ sngar dang mi 'dra bar shin tu rnying shing*/ mgon khang ni rdib la khad rang 'dugade na da dung rten ngo mtshar can 'dra ni bzhugs 'dugazangs dkar lo tsā bas bzhengs pa'i rdor dbyings lha khangade kha che'i lugs su 'dug cing*/

lha sa'i dkyil 'khor steng na zangs dkar gyis bzo bkod cig mdzad 'dug pa/ de kha 'dra ba cig 'di na'ang gda'/ nyams dang gzhig 'jug yod rlom rnams kyis gzigs na ngo e mkhyen nam/ de nas yar 'ongs rtag brtan du'ang zhag lnga las ma bsdad/ dpal gyi jo nang du lo dus kyi 'khrid tshugs par byas/ 'khrid gsar pa phyed dang nyis brgya tsam byung zhing*/ lo snga ma gnyis kyi shugs rgyab pa 'dra ba zhig gis 'khrid lo legs po rang ma byung*/ sog po kha sog gi grwa ris nyi shu rtsa 'dren yod pa rnams lo gcig rtag brtan du slob gnyer 'dra byas 'di skabs thams cad kyis sbyor drug zhus/ snying rus chen pos dam po thang ma rang rgyab/ 'khrid grol nas dge slong sgrub mkhan yang mang du byung*/ mar yul bdag po ye shes dbang phyug pa yang chos zhu la phebs/ dam po yang dag pa mdzad/ dus 'khrid spyi chos grol rjes bdag po dang*/ pa snam skyid phug nas mnga' bdag sku skye'i drung dang*/ papapapapapapapapapapa khams pa rag khrom bla ma shes rab chos 'phel sogs nyi shu skor zhig la/ srog rtsol sogs yan lag phyi ma rnams kyang rdzogs par bshad/ shun zhabs drung nas ni ngas dang po glang lo shun du phyin skabs/ shun rdzong la khyed kyis dgon pa 'debs dgos gsung du byung*/ ma babs thugs khog 'tshab pa'i stab stob kyi gsung du 'dug na'ang*/ bla chen gzhan zhig yin na/ tshig zur de kha la cag 'jus byas pa'i rjes la rtsab rtsub mdzad rgyu ga la 'ong*/ nged ni rtsod pa can de 'dra la zhe 'dod kyang gtan nas med/ phugs kyang zar zir gyi rgyu kho nar 'gro ba 'dug pas/ de 'dra ye mi 'thad zhes lar ma blangs pa yin/ de rjes bya lo'i skabs kyi gnas gshis la/ sku tshe hril po bzang btson du bzhugs dgos kyi sgo dod pa de khar 'dug kyang*/ nged kyis thabs gang grag ci grag nan tan du zhus pa la brten nas/ sne'u nas yar phebs chog pa'i dam 'jur ci gar grol/

rog tsho sku skal du byung ba sogs bya ba'i gshis la dpags pa'i phan thogs che rab byung*/ de skabs rang de 'jigs pa chen po las thar ba des zhabs drung rang yang thugs dgyes bzhin du/ khyed drin che zhes yang yang gsung gin yang 'dugade dus kyi gtsang gnas bka' bkod dang bka' shog gnyis kar du/ rong tsho'i yong sgo rnams zhabs drung rang la yong pa gzhir bcas/ g.yog rigs kyang gtsang sbras chod pa yin mod/ zhabs drung rang bzhugs yul rtag brtan rang du rgyun bzhugs mdzad dgos gsung ba yod na'ang*/ dgon par bzhugs pa la gu dog gi bzhugs nus rigs min pa 'dug pas/ dgongs pa zhus nas rog tshor bzhugs chog pa'ang byung ba yin/ de lta na yang bgres 'tshal gyi rnam pa dang*/ gdon gyis bskyod pa'i rkyen gyis/ thugs 'gyur kha yang zhing thugs sna mang ba/ sdig pa la dgyes pa/ thugs gtod sa yang yang yang 'phos 'gro zhing/ sna tshogs sh-ig gis zar zir mang po rgyun ldan du mdzad pa cig byung*/ khyad par 'di skabs dgun smad de/ zhabs drung rang dang dgos pa dpon g.yog gnyis kyis dgos med la/ g.yog po tsho la dkrug sbyor mdzad nas/ rog tshor mi phar bsad tshur bsad 'ga' re byung*/ gzhan yang zar zir ya ri ma ri mang po yong rtsis 'dug pas/ dpyid ka de zhabs drung rang rtag brtan du gdan 'dren dgos byung*/ de nas hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la rtag brtan tshogs su sangs rgyas rjes dran gyi man ngag rang re'i nyams len de thog mar bshad/ grub mtha' bzhi'i bshad pa zhag 'ga' re byas/ de rjes na nang gi 'phros nas theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan gyi phar phyin drug gi le'u nas brtsams/ mthar phyin pa yongs su rdzogs kyi bar song*/ de yang rtsa 'grel gnyis kar gyi go don dpyis phyin pa dang*/ sngon gyi lo paṇa rnams kyi gsung 'phros ngo mtshar can mang pos kyang brgyan/ zer lo tsam ma yin par chos skad grub mtha' gting tshugs pa'i mtha' gcod byas te bshad pa yin/

spyir 'dzin chos rim pas btang*/ lo zla mang po sbrel nas bshad na ma gtogs/ mtshan nyid kyi gra chen po cig tu yang*/ spyi chos bzabs nas bshad kyang*/ gzhung de go zhig shes pa srid mtha' tsam min pa mi yong bar 'dug pas/ 'di kun tu ni phal cher la go rtogs yong ba dka' bar 'duga'on kyang tshig re tshig gnyis kyi go ba nas kyang mang du phan thogs par 'dug cig sems la'ang phan pa dang*/ gzhug blo la gzung ba tsho la go ba legs rab shar ba yang gda'/ smad cha 'di la bla chen ye shes drung gis zin bris kyang mdzad thub po/ / sngar gyi de nas 'gyang tsam song ba na/ skabs shig nas rnal sad pa 'dra ba zhig gis/ 'di skabs sde pa gzhung nas rog tshor mngags mi mang ba gser srang lnga bcu'i chad sgrub zhu 'chag med par rang sgrub dgos sogs dam tshig la gnod pa'i zar zir mang po byung*/ gros pa tsho'i skyon ni yin par 'duga'adir rgyas bar smos ma dgos/ rang gzhan thams cad la dngos su rgyus yod pa de yin/ rten 'brel 'chugs pas gzhung sa rang du zhabs 'dren ni shin tu che'o/ / rgyal ba'i sras kyi gzhung lam chen po zab cing rgya che ba de 'chad pa'i lhongs ni yin par 'dugagazhung 'di'i nyan bshad kyi chos grwa nub nas rgyang tsam song 'dug pas/ nyams pa slar gso ba la lhongs yong yang thang ba yin/ bod 'di na 'gong po spun dgu sogs yul mtha' gzhan nas gsar du sleb pa'i 'dre gdug rtsub can mang po 'dug pa rnams mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rnam dag 'go gzhug tshang bar 'chad pa la shin tu mi dga' bar byed par snang ngo*/ / de rjes tshogs pa la spyan ras gzigs padma dra ba'i dbang zhig byas/ dngos gzhi'i nyi ma dang de'i phyi nyin gnyis/ shin tu na ba'i 'tshub tu mngon pa cig byung*/ bar skabs der don gnyer 'ga' la thub pa dgongs rgyan gyi lung dang*/ shan ti pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i 'grel pa sogs rang res rtsams chos 'ga' shas kyi lung bshad dang*/

nai gu'i skor dang lam 'bras sogs/ so sor 'dong chos kyi rigs gang la gang 'tshams mang du bshad/ sbrul lo rtse phyogs la phyin dus/ 'bras spungs kyi khang pa'i ze sbron pa byas pa rnams bkod pa bzhin ma byung ba'i 'di skabs slar bcos skyor dgos pa rnams bcos pa'i dbyar thog de kha la zhal ba dang shing rtsi tshun chod legs par grub/ de skabs rang de mar yul bdag po rang gi dgongs gtad ston tsam thub 'di khar bzhugs/ chos gang thob mdzad/ de rjes bsnyen rdzogs sgrubs nas stod phyogs la 'byon bzhed cig 'dug na'ang*/ phyi nang gsang ba ya kha ma kha 'dra'i rkyen gyis/ sde srid gzhung nas 'bod mi dus tshes nges can 'ur rdo skor gcig ma blo rdeg tu gnang*/ lam 'bras kyang zhu 'phro la bzhag ste phebs dgos byung song ba/ khong shin tu mi dgyes pa rang mdzad kyin 'dugaphyis thar par mi bzhugs pa'i rkyen yar de la thug gda'/ lo snga phyi 'di pa la bdag po chos rje'i gsung gi dgongs gtad ltar gu ge'i yul mtha' pi ta'i go mig zer ba'i dgon pa de 'dzin mkhan cig gtong dgos par byung*/

de la gu ge'i jo bo bdag po la zhu dgos byung zhing*/ tshur gnang yang byung*/ spyi babs bla ma che gra so sos sde dpon rigs kyi gros phugs mdzad cing*/ tha na gnyen kha tsun chad byed pa'i srol cig dus phyis yul ga na'ang 'dugakhyad par stod phyogs kun na de lta bu ngo mtshar che zhing bzang bar rtsi ba cig yod 'dug pa'i spyan shugs dang*/ khyad par ya phyogs kun du 'tshams ral btod pa'i dge 'brug ngor gsum gyi grwa rigs tshos/ sde pa gtsang pa'i gros phugs de nged kyi byed kyi yod rgyu ba rang*/ ra 'thag 'tshog 'tshog byas pa de la gsan pa'i gzhir bzhag rang mdzad kyin 'dugakhong rnams de skad zer ba'i rgyu mtshan de yang sde srid gong ma de skabs/ sngar gtsang pa rang gi dgra phyogs kyi khungs rnams lta ci smos/ nye khul tshos kyang*/ mtho gnon dang 'gro 'tshams kyis dgra byas pa dang*/ khong pa'i las shugs dbang thang 'bar ba gnyis thug nas/ thams cad stong song pa de ka la/ ngas byas rgyu til 'bru tsam zhig med kyang*/ de nged la khag bskur na nged tsho la smad ra rgya che gting zab rang yong rgyu'i khungs kyis smras pas yin par 'dug/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ lung bstan yin zer ba'i shob rang tshig re re gnyis gnyis 'don zhing*/ gzhan tsho chos rgyal yin gtsang pa bdud yin zer ba de la thugaskya ser byin dmangs 'di yang de khas mgo 'khor 'gro yin 'dugagang na'ang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam 'phrul lkog gyur ni bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i spyod yul yin pas/ ye shes kyi spyan yod pa cig gis gzigs na/ da lta yang dpag tu med pa cig yong ni yod par 'dugangos ni sus kyang mi zin/ de 'dra la ni dus bzang ngan med do/ / mngon 'gyur ba la ni dus bzang ngan yod pa dngos su grub/ da lta mang po med pa de yin gzhan 'jig rten dkar phyogs kyi lha chen po mi'i lus 'dzin pa lha'i 'jug pa dang*/

nags phyogs kyi 'dre srin mi'i lus 'dzin pa bong ba ltar na bdud sprul zhes sam/ lha min gyi 'jug pa dngos de ni/ dus deng sang mi yong ba yin/ rgyu mtshan ni sngon gyi mi'i lus de rtsa khams dwangs/ rtsa'i nus pa che bas ya mtshan chen po ci yang 'byung la/ phyis kyi rnams de las ldog pa'i phyir ro/ / mtha' na ro langs tshun chad kyang da lta sngon bzhin mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ de'i tshab tu deng sang dkar phyogs kyi lha'am nag phyogs kyi 'dres/ mi so so'i blo bsgyur ba dang/ mig gis mi mthong ba'i phyogs nas rgyal pham gyi dpung byed pa kho na yin pa go dgos/ lung bstan mkhan rnams bag yod 'tshal/ rgya gar ba mkhas pa rnams na re/ sngon lha min gyi 'jug pa'i rgyal po byung ste/ mi rnams la gnod pa byed pa'i tshab/ deng sang gi mi la de ltar mi 'byung bas/ da lta kla klo'i chos lugs dar/ de rnams stobs dang ldan zhing thub par dka' ba yin zer/ yang ci ste da ltar yang de ltar yong zhes dbu tshugs smra na/ 'phags pa dang dkar phyogs kyi lha ma yin phyin/ mi phal pa gang yang go rig mi yong ba'i zam zom lkug pa sgro zha ba de 'dra las/ gnam the'u dang*/ 'bal the'u sogs yin kyang brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur gyis grag mod/ 'di tshos rang gzhan gnyis ka'i bya byed stobs chen grub 'ong*/ cig shos des gang yang mi yong ba lags zhes brjod par bya'o/ / skabs kyi don la/ sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal des gsung phebs la/ nged kyis rgyal srid kyi bya ba rlabs chen 'grub/ da dung skyong ba la dka' las mi 'dug kyang*/ 'byor pa yod pa'i tshogs gsog dang*/ snga phyi'i sgrib sbyongs su gtsug lag khang sogs la brten pa'i dge ba rlabs che ba zhig dgos 'dug pa/ skye bo mi nag pas kha 'jug bkod khyab byas kyang bza' sgo dang tho cho'i spyod pa la song*/ thams cad du tho chen po 'phog cing*/

sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i gnad du 'gro ba zhig dka' bar 'dugad lta grwa rigs yon bdag dar rgyas che ba kun la'ang*/ phyogs med du gus pas zhabs tog byed pa gzhir bcas yin/ dpal jo nang pa'i lugs 'di da lta nub la khad 'dug pa cung zad gso thub na/ dkon pa tsam gyi rin thang che'i dpe phan yon yang che ba dang*/ chos tshul 'di la rang res mos pa'ang yin gsung*/ snga phyir sa cha dang*/ yo byad thams cad sbyor 'jags gnang*/ nged tshos dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs rgyu de'i lag len khyed kyis byed dgos tshul don gyi gnad kyi 'dugakhong rang bzhugs dus don la'ang de kha rang yin/ de tsam ma gtogs de dus kyang dus zings kyi gros phugs nyi ma gcig kyang byed ma myong*/ de lta ni khog gros kyi dra dri tsam yang med pa 'di ka yin/ 'di skabs kyang jo bo bdag po'i thugs bsam la/ gros phugs yin pa'i khungs rang gi bka' phebs sku don rnam grangs mang po dang*/ khyad par gnyen bsgrigs byed dgos tshul sogs 'duganged rang rtogs ldan la mdzu gu 'dzugs rgyu zhig mi 'dug kyang*/ ngas dran tsam gyi dus na gtsang phyogs 'di kun na/ dge bshes kyi ming can gyis gnyen kha byed pa la/ kun gyis 'cha' ba'i khrel yod chen po dgos pa'i mig rgyugs kyis/ sngar de 'dra ci yang zer ma myong bas rang res ni ye ma byas/ khong mur btugs ches pa dang*/ sde srid gzhung rang du'ang*/ tshong pa'i khra bsdud phran tshegs la rtseg 'dam dang*/ thugs snyung ba'i tshod byas na/ stod phyogs thams cad 'du ba'i legs lam du yang 'gro ba 'dra bsams par 'dugamadzod pas zhu shog phul yang skyo ma snga btsan gyi dbang las ma byung 'dugade thugs rtsol gyis 'grub na sde pa rang la legs rgyur 'dug ste/ nor rnams kun gyi nang na chog shes pa/ zhes pa'i don thugs la 'khrungs na ni pho skyes rgyab gda'o/ / dbyar smad kyi dus zab chen rgyu gang bzang la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa zab dkyil chen mor grags pa 'di yang bzhengs/

rgyu tshogs tshang ma sdoms na/ zab chen yug ring thung sna tshogs pa brgya skor cig song*/ thog ma'i bgegs skrod rab gnas la shin tu bkra lod cing 'tshub tu mngon pa ja blugs pa tsam gyi dkar yol don med du sgra dang bcas cha gnyis su gas byung zhing*/ de nyin ka rtse nas 'bod mkhan zhig kyang sleb byung bas/ rten 'brel mi legs par shes nas/ da res shar phyogs mi 'gro bar thag bcad do/ / hor zla dgu pa'i 'go stod la/ gting skyes nas sde pa yab sras dang*/ rtse gdong nas lcam drung sogs dpon g.yog mang rab zhig nged dang 'phrad pa dang*/ 'di phyogs kyi rten mjal la phebs/ zhag nyi shu skor bzhugs/ tshe dbang brgya tshar dang*/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dbang bskur dang*/ dpal mgon po'i bka' sogs rjes gnang mang rab dang bcas pa gsan song*/ bla ma rin po che ka bzhi sprul pa'i sku yang dpal thar pa gling gi 'dzin skyong la phebs pa'ang 'di ka'i dus ka yin/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa de nyid/ sku dbyings su thim pa'i dus nges can rdzun med rang cig ni rdzu bag mang grags pas things pa dka' ba 'dugadabyar smad de sku rim yin zer ba mang bskol mang rab mdzad 'dug pa'i/ rtag brtan du yang mang ja 'gyed bcas bsngo rten gyi skal ba gnas byung*/ zla ba 'di la gsang rtol byung*/ zla ba bcu pa'i nang du 'di tshor dgongs rdzogs kyi skal ba'ang bzang bar byung*/ nged kyi bsam mno zhig la/ rtogs ldan 'di kun gyi kha nas bka' brgyud rin po che la thug 'dug yang yang zer ba de yang*/ 'dra mo ru yang gda'/ mnyam med dpal sgam po pa rang gi dus dang*/ bde gshegs khams pa dang*/ 'bri khung rin chen dpal sogs kyi spyan ltos kyi gzhug de da rung 'dugabla chen bcol na bla chen pher pa de bka' brgyud pa 'di la ka gda'o snyam pa cig byung*/ 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchog gi sprul sku yang*/ khro phur phebs 'dug pas gzhi byes la mang ja dang*/

ja zhal bzab tsam phul/ dgyes pa'i tshul gyi gsung phebs khral khrol du mdzad kyin yod 'dug cing*/ gdab lan rtag brtan du mang ja dang*/ nged la'ang ja 'dren mdzad byung 'di na bla chen gyi khungs la la zhig 'brel 'dra byas na/ lci thang thang 'grangs ma gtsang po de 'dra min pa'i 'brel 'tshol ba la spro ba skyes yod pa'i rigs yin par der 'dug lags/ de nas ri khrod chen po'i dus khrid yang sngar lugs bzhin btsugs/ khrid gsar pa sngar 'khyud bzhin mang ba dang*/ lo snga ma gsum btud las 'khrid lo legs tsam gyi 'bring pa cig byung*/ lo 'di'i nang du jo nang gi lha khang bde ba can du/ ldem byang chub sems dpa' gnyis dang logs bris dang steng gi thigs khang sogs thams cad grub/ rgya gar gyi yul nub phyogs ku ru'i brgyud nas bram ze'i rigs kyi paṇḍi ta gzhon nu sgra la mkhas pa ba la bha dra zhes pa zhig lo snga ma la 'dir byung*/ lha sa sogs bod yul gyi skor 'os rnams bskor/ slar 'di skabs 'byor byung ba/ khong re zhig sdod par byas nas/ swa ra swa sti bya ka ra ṇa/ dbyangs can sgra mdo rtsa 'grel sngar cung zad bsgyur ba'i 'phros nas/ 'gyur byed pa'i 'go brtsams/ brel g.yeng stabs nas yun rings 'god/ zhag re'i nang du thun re tsam byas/ rtsa 'grelaganyis po gang bsgyur tshar ba de'i rgyu la/ lag len nag po 'gro shes re yang nyin re bzhin bris/ hor zla gnyis pa la rtag brtan du phyin/ chos than thun 'dra bshad/ ngam ring mkhan chen klu sgrub sprul pa'i sku yang*/ yos lo brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa dang*/ gur sam gnyis la bshad 'doms tsam gsan skabs de nas/ bar skabs der mjal ma thub pas/ cis kyang yong dgos 'dug gsung phebs/ bde mchog nag po lugs kyi rim bzhi lam slong chen mo dang*/ sbyor drug dang gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor thor bu 'ga' dang*/ rjes gnang ci rigs pa dgos gsung ba ltar phul/

de la spyir bod yul 'di ru chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ lo paṇa sprul pa'i skyes mchog rnams kyi bka' drin las/ chos kyi sgo mtha' yas pa sna ma 'gags par 'gyur zhing dar ba yin/ dgos su bstan pa phyi dar la/ rgya gar nyi 'og dang*/ kha che bal po kun dar zhing grags che ba'i gsang sngags kyi chos kyi rkangs phal cher zhig 'gyur ba yin/ rgyud 'ga' shas tsam lus 'dugadagongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos ni ma 'gyur ba ches mang mod tshad gzung mi nus la/ kha cig med kyang a'u rtsi mod/ yang rgya gar nas brgyud pa'i chos re re tsam la sa bon blangs te/ bod yul 'dir rang rang gi blo gros kyis rgya cher spel ba yang mang du byung*/ kha cig tu zhal mthong dang*/ lung bstan dang*/ rmi lam dang*/ sngar mthong thos med kyang*/ blo la rang shar ba'i nyams chos sam/ rtogs chos shin tu mang ba dag byung ngo*/ / rgya bod gnyis kar du/ rgyud gtsor byed pa dang*/ gdams ngag gtso bor byed pa so sor byung*/ rgyud gang yang rung ba cig la brten nas/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ lha sngags kyi rnal 'byor nges can du byed/ de la brten nas bskyed rdzogs la slob pa ni/ rgyud gtso bor byas pa cis zer/ dbang bskur dang lha'i rnal 'byor cig la gzhung srong ba'i nges gzung med par/ rtsa rlung ngam/ sems phyogs sogs rtsal du 'don pa ni/ man ngag gtso bor byed pa zhes grags/ rgya gar gyi dpyod ldan rnams rgyud gtso bor byed pa la rtsis che/ bod du ni man ngag gtso bor byed pa kho na dar rgyas che'o/ / rgyud gtso bor ston pa'i chos 'di rnams rgyu dang yi dam la phyogs 'dzin byas pa'i re re tsam min pa bod yul 'di na/ phyis dar rgyas chung bar 'dugakho bo ni rgyud dang 'brel ba'i chos rnam dag 'di rnams la yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po ni yod/ sdug zhen ni gang yod yod byed/ dar thub pa'i nus pa ni nga rang la yang mi gda' ste/

de las kyang sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa ma nor ba'i sngags chos zab mo la thos pa dang*/ sgom pa byed pa'i bsod nams kyi skal ba can de 'dra rgyal khams yongs kyi mi 'di pa'i sa na mang po yod yod mi 'dra bas/ chos zab mo spel thub pa'i thes mi gda'/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas kyis ni ma gsungs na/ / dka' bas 'bad nas byed pa mtshar/ / zhes pa ltar/ rgyud kyi brten so 'di yin med pa'i rigs tshogs chen cig la'ang*/ 'bad brtsol gyis thos sgom byed tshul ci rigs ni yong gin gda'/ gzhan phal che ba ni/ snyoms las dang sla chos kho na gtso bor 'don pas/ nya chos sad sud dang 'ad 'ud shab shob 'dra la/ blo 'gro ba tsam ma gtogs/ chos dbyings che ba la mos pa tsam yang mi skye ba der gda'o/ / 'o na rgyud dang 'brel pa'i chos 'gangs che ba da lta rgyun ma 'chad pa ni ji lta bu yin da lta ji tsam yod snyam na de 'dra ni 'di dag yin te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags skor du grags pa'i dbang bskur ba dang/ sgron gsal la brten pa'i rgyud kyi bshad pa rim lnga spyod sdus dang 'brel pa'i rdzogs rim dang bcas pa mar 'gos gnyis 'dus kyi dbang lung man ngag cha tshang rnams rkangs tshugs pa'i srol ka gcig yin te dang po'o/ / yang 'dus pa la/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi lugs/ lo tsā ba ye shes rgyal mtshan/ yon tan grags/ dar ma grags rnams nas brgyud pa gtso bor gyur pa dbang bka' rgyud bshad rdzogs rim grol ba'i thig le sogs dbang rgyud man ngag cha tshang ba yod pa 'di ni rkang tshugs pa'i sde tshan gnyis pa yin no/ / dpal gshin rje gshed kyi phyogs la/ rwa lo'i bzhed kyi nag po skor gsum gyi dbang bka'/ gtso bor nag 'jigs kyi rgyud bshad las tshogs mtha' rgyas/ phyis kyi blo bzo'i bsre slad med pa'i rdzogs rim dang bcas pa 'di rkang tshugs pa gsum pa yin no/ / lo tsa ba shes rab bla ma dang*/

'od kyi 'byung gnas dang*/ blo gros grags rnams kyi lugs la'ang dbang bshad man ngag rkang tshugs pa yod kyang phyis dar rgyas chung bas snga ma'i zhor byung du bgrangs so/ / gshin rje gshed dmar po lugs gnyis la lo tsā ba chos kyi dpal bzang po dang*/ chos rje dpal zang po dang*/ shes rab rin chen dang*/ mkhas pa sbyin pa tshul khrims rnams nas brgyud pa'i gdams ngag bcas/ so so'i dbang bka'/ shin tu spros med dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i rdzogs rim/ byin rlabs kyi bka' rgya gzhung gi zin so can mang po dang*/ gzhung gi bshad pa las tshogs dang bcas pa/ rgyab rten rgyud sogs cha tshang bar yod pa 'di ni rkang tshugs pa bzhi pa'o/ / dgyes pa rdo rje la lo tsā ba shaka ye dang*/ lo tsā ba bsod nams rtse mo gnyis 'dzoms pa'i rtsa bshad kyi dkyil 'khor dbang bka' mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis tsam dang*/ rgyud gsum du grags pa'i bshad pa/ zab pa'i tshul dgu/ lhan cig skyes grub/ lhan cig skyes pa'i man ngag sogs dang*/ gzhug 'grel mang po'i lung bka' dang bcas pa 'di ni rkang tshugs pa lnga pa'o/
